articles.title: Dems seize the Senate as blue tidal wave crashes deep into Trump country, topples GOP strongholds

paras.en: AUSTIN, Texas — Democrats pulled off a spectacular drubbing of Republicans to reclaim power in the Senate Tuesday night, even without every race up for grabs across the map being decided.

Democrats’ reclaiming of the upper chamber means that Republicans’ near two-year control of the federal government since President Donald Trump’s meteoric return to power will come to an end in January when the 120th Congress gavels into session.

And they did so by carving a blue gash deep into Trump country, toppling several candidates that the president handpicked in many races that, until the waning weeks of the midterm election cycle, appeared out of reach for Democrats.

The wave started in Georgia, where Sen. Jon Ossoff, D-Ga., easily beat Rep. Mike Collins, R-Ga., and continued rolling through North Carolina, South Carolina, Kansas, Iowa and Texas, where Senator-elect Rep. James Talarico, currently a state senator, handed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton a historic and decisive defeat in the Lone Star State.
"We just took back Texas," Talarico told a roaring crowd of supporters Tuesday night.
As Tuesday rolled into Wednesday, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., had clinched five pickups already, eviscerating Republicans’ thin, 53-seat majority in the upper chamber.
The wave could still continue into Tuesday and roil through the GOP, with major races still outstanding that could swing Democrats’ way before the midterms are through.
Contests in Michigan, Minnesota and Alaska were still outstanding, but even if Democrats lose those races, they’ll still claim power in the Senate.
And coupled with a majority in the House, that means that Trump’s agenda in Congress will likely grind to a complete halt.

Blame among Republicans was already flying as the dust continued to settle election night, with Trump, the quality of candidates running in tight races, and the top Republican running the Senate’s campaign arm, Sen. Tim Scott, R-S.C., coming under an immediate and harsh microscope.
"When the NRSC Chairman loses his home state of SOUTH CAROLINA…," a GOP operative told Fox News Digital.
Whether Schumer will be the one to lead Senate Democrats, however, remains in the air.

Many of the candidates that scored a ticket to Washington, D.C., have remained noncommittal, or outright refused, to support him, arguing that the Senate Democratic caucus needed generational change in leadership.

articles.title: Trump congratulates Democrats after dominant midterms, says he looks forward to working with them

paras.en: President Donald Trump congratulated Democrats, saying he looked forward to working with them for the good of the United States following a difficult Election Day for Republicans.

The Fox News Decision Desk projected a wave of Democratic victories, giving the party control of both the House and Senate. Trump warned earlier in the day that he would be quick to veto Democratic legislation if Republicans lost power, but struck a conciliatory tone when speaking to CBS News once results came in.
"My message is congratulations to the Democrats, and I look forward to working with you for the good of our country," Trump told CBS News late Tuesday.
"I think they're gonna want to work with me," he continued. "Otherwise, I'd just veto everything, and they're not gonna want that."
Trump previously made it clear he remained confident in his ability to pursue the MAGA agenda despite the outcome of the midterms.
"I have the ultimate power — it's called 'veto,'" Trump previously told CBS News.
During the earlier conversation, Trump suggested that his veto power could force Democrats to come to the bargaining table.
"Historically, you veto for a couple of months, and then they come and say, 'We've got to make a deal,'" Trump said.
Republicans lost key races across the country as Democrats secured victories in the midterm elections. Trump attributed the results in part to his absence from the ballot.

"I feel that I wasn't on the ballot, and there was nothing that could be done about that. If I was, we would have won," Trump said. "In some cases, they didn't like the candidates, and in some cases those candidates were not my friend, and the base knows that better than anybody. And they stayed back."
Later in the evening, Trump spoke with Fox News Channel and again stressed that he planned to use the "power of veto" to block Democratic-backed legislation.
"It's one of the stronger powers that a president has," Trump told "Special Report" anchor Bret Baier during live election-night coverage.

"And they'll send over things that are insane and I'll veto them. And after a couple of months of vetoes, they'll go out, and they'll say, 'How do we get this stuff done? And we'll work together,'" he added. "You know, I have a lot of friends that are Democrats, believe it or not, I've already spoken to some of them."
Fox News Digital's Landon Mion contributed to this report.

articles.title: Netanyahu faces coalition showdown as rivals maneuver to form Israel's next government

paras.en: TEL AVIV, Israel: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s hold on power in Israel will be tested Wednesday as President Isaac Herzog begins consultations with leaders of all parties elected to the 26th Knesset before deciding which lawmaker to task with forming the next government.

The final vote count, published last Friday by Israel's Central Elections Committee, gave Netanyahu's bloc 53 seats in the 120-member Knesset, compared with 48 for the opposition alliance led by Gadi Eisenkot — 61 seats are needed to form a government.

On Monday, Netanyahu posted to X that "the public in Israel does not want a government that depends on Ra'am and the Joint List—parties that support terrorism and reject the existence of the Jewish state."

"A clear majority in the Jewish public chose the Likud as the largest party and me, as prime minister, to lead the next government. We aspire to form a broad government with our partners and with any party that wishes to do so and does not support terrorism. I am open to holding discussions on the matter," he added.

The two predominantly Arab parties he pointed his criticism at are the Joint List and Ra'am who secured a historic combined total of 19 seats, potentially positioning them as kingmakers in the government formation process.

A Joint List source told Fox News Digital that the alliance is likely to endorse Eisenkot to be the first lawmaker tasked with forming a government. If both predominantly Arab parties were to back him, he would receive recommendations from parties representing more than the 61 seats needed.
The lawmaker tasked with forming a government will have 28 days to do so, with the president authorized to grant an extension of up to 14 additional days.
Consultations will be held in ascending order of seat count, beginning with Religious Zionism-Zehut and Shas, which each won six seats, followed by Yisrael Beiteinu, which secured seven.

On Thursday, Herzog will meet with the leaders of United Torah Judaism and Otzma Yehudit, which each won seven seats, followed by The Democrats and Ra'am, which each won eight, the Joint List (11), BeYachad (12), Yashar (21) and Likud (27).

Defense and government affairs commentator Amir Oren told Fox News Digital that while Herzog is formally free to choose whom to task with forming a government, he would be inclined to select the candidate whose nomination is backed by parties representing a majority of Knesset seats.
"He must then task Eisenkot with forming the next government. That does not mean Eisenkot will succeed. If he fails, he will have to return the mandate to the president," Oren said.

Eisenkot may, in fact, struggle to assemble a 61-seat governing coalition, given competing interests within the opposition bloc. BeYachad leader Naftali Bennett and Yisrael Beiteinu chief Avigdor Liberman are unlikely to agree to serve in a government reliant on the Joint List, given the latter’s pro-Palestinian positions and opposition to Zionism.
It is theoretically possible, however, that the opposition bloc could agree to form a minority government with the Arab parties providing support from outside the coalition.

While Israel has no precedent for forming a minority government immediately following an election, such arrangements have occurred during a Knesset term. Most recently, during Netanyahu’s current term, one of the ultra-Orthodox parties withdrew from the coalition over a dispute related to military conscription but continued to support the government from outside.
Religious Zionism-Zehut, Otzma Yehudit and Shas each confirmed to Fox News Digital on Tuesday night that they would recommend Netanyahu to Herzog during consultations on forming a government.

Dan Diker, president of the Jerusalem Center for Security and Foreign Affairs, told Fox News Digital that Bennett and Liberman’s recent endorsement of Eisenkot suggests they are moving away from the prospect of a national unity government.

"I think it would behoove Netanyahu, Eisenkot, former Prime Minister Bennett and former Defense Minister Liberman to find a way to work together now, given the imminent clash between the apocalyptic death cult known as the Iranian regime, Israel and, by extension, the rest of the Western world," he said.

Complicating matters for Netanyahu, the 26th Knesset is scheduled to be sworn in on Nov. 10. Its newly elected members are expected to begin forming committees and advancing legislation, while the current prime minister and ministers remain in office and continue carrying out their duties under the oversight of the new parliament, ensuring continuity of government.

"They are doing everything they can to push Netanyahu out of office, and we are seeing that now with discussions about replacing the Knesset speaker. They can then begin trying to advance legislation in a Knesset with 19 seats held by Arab parties that would be very uncomfortable for Netanyahu," Diker said.

Oren highlighted another potential challenge, suggesting that the caretaker government's ability to launch military operations could face political constraints, potentially complicating any resumption of hostilities with Iran, even if U.S. President Donald Trump were to initiate such action.

Former Knesset member Dov Lipman told Fox News Digital that Eisenkot appears likely to be the first lawmaker tasked with forming a government, but suggested that most Israelis favor a national unity government built around Likud, Yashar and BeYachad, with one or more smaller parties also joining.

"As a first step, Eisenkot may approach Likud and ask it to join a government under his leadership, which Likud will reject. Eisenkot will then have to make a decision, as Liberman is unlikely to agree to serve in a government alongside Arab parties," Lipman said.
"Eisenkot will likely fail to form a government, after which the mandate will pass to Netanyahu, who will also likely fail."

That would trigger a 21-day period during which any Knesset member could attempt to form a government with the backing of at least 61 lawmakers. If the process reaches that stage, Eisenkot might agree to serve under Netanyahu for two years to avoid sending the country to another election, Lipman said.

Prof. Gideon Rahat, a senior fellow at the Israel Democracy Institute, told Fox News Digital that Netanyahu would need to make concessions to persuade opposition leaders that he would honor his commitments, given their experience with the 2020 power-sharing agreement with then-Blue and White party leader Benny Gantz.

Under the agreement, Netanyahu was to serve as prime minister for the first 18 months, with Gantz serving as alternate prime minister and defense minister before taking over as premier on Nov. 17, 2021. However, the arrangement unraveled after the government failed to pass a state budget by the December 2020 deadline, triggering the Knesset's automatic dissolution and new elections. Gantz never assumed the premiership.
Rahat pointed to Israel’s 1984-1988 national unity government as a precedent, saying a similar arrangement could work.

"At the time, Israel was still embroiled in the Lebanon War, with IDF forces deployed in the country, while the economy was facing a severe crisis, with annual inflation exceeding 400%. Against that backdrop, Likud and Labor formed a national unity government under a rotation agreement, with Shimon Peres serving as prime minister for the first two years, followed by Yitzhak Shamir for the next two," he said.
While large parts of the public would likely support it, Rahat said, there are still issues that may create tension.

"They will have to freeze the judicial overhaul launched by Netanyahu’s government, find a way to investigate Oct. 7, as demanded by opposition parties and agree on a mechanism for Netanyahu to leave office when the time comes. But when it comes to major issues of security and the economy, unity governments can be quite effective," Rahat said.
"Once they resolve the major challenges, however, they start fighting among themselves and the magic is over."

articles.title: UK apologises to Ukrainian child refugees who were told to study Russian
articles.author: Matthew Weaver

paras.en: The UK has apologised to Ukrainian child refugees who were told to study Russian in English schools, as it launched funding for a new GCSE in Ukrainian.

Ukrainian children who were forced to seek refuge in the UK after Vladimir Putin’s invasion in 2022 say it was “insulting” that their teachers suggested they study Russian in the absence of a GCSE in Ukrainian.

Announcing the new qualification, the schools minister, Georgia Gould, said: “So many students were pushed into having to do Russian. I’m really sorry that they were put in that position. It’s really important that they will have access to a Ukrainian GCSE.”
The new qualification, which will be ready in England in 2028, is being developed by the AQA exam board, with the help of a £340,000 grant from the Department for Education.

It comes after years of lobbying from the Ukrainian government and Ukrainian community groups on behalf of more than 30,000 Ukrainian children who have fled to the UK. In a letter to the DfE in 2024, the education ministry in Kyiv said: “We are deeply concerned that due to the lack of Ukrainian GCSE, many Ukrainian children are being pressured by their school staff to pass the Russian GCSE.”

Gould said: “It was one of the Ukrainian government’s asks of us that we deliver a Ukrainian GCSE, and one of the asks from the community and young people. We’re really proud to be able to do it, and proud of that partnership with the Ukrainian government.”
The Ukrainian language has been at the cultural frontline of the conflict with Russia. Putin has banned Ukrainian books and the teaching of Ukrainian in land Russia has occupied.
Gould said: “Whether it’s military support or this the kind of cultural support, our message as a British government is we stand absolutely steadfast behind the Ukrainian people.”

Ukraine’s education minister, Andrii Butenko, said he was grateful to the UK government. He said: “This will give Ukrainian children forced to leave their homes by Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine an equal opportunity to choose their native language as a GCSE subject. We will continue working with AQA and the DfE to develop a high-quality and accessible qualification.”

Gould made the announcement on a visit to St Mary’s school in west London, the centre of a network of 13 Ukrainian-language schools in the UK. She was introduced to Vitalii Andronik, 20, who told the Guardian in 2024 how he had been urged to study Russian GCSE as a 15-year-old refugee. Gould told him: “I’m really sorry that you were put in that position.”

Andronik welcomed the new qualification and the apology. He said: “It’s too late to me, but I want future generations of refugees to study Ukrainian. It’s a recognition of the trauma that we went through. It’s brilliant news to hear that in future kids here won’t have to study Russian.”

Sofiia Chonka, 16, who fled to London from Zakarpattia in south-west Ukraine in June 2024 with her family, said: “I was told to study Russia in year 9, I just said ‘no’. I didn’t want anything to do with Russia – they killed my people and injured my family.”
Chonka, who has just started A-levels, said she would take the new exam when it was available. “It’s such a beautiful thing to be speaking Ukrainian when the Russians are trying to mute you.”
She added: “I’m really sad that it has taken so long, but at least they are starting the process, and some of my younger friends will have the opportunity to do it.
“It’s a stereotype that they are similar languages – they are completely different. Because Ukrainian is so beautiful, the Russians don’t like it. They can’t ban it, they can’t ban people.”

Inna Hryhorovych, the head of St Mary’s Trust, who has been calling for the GCSE since Russia’s annexation of Crimea in 2014, said: “It’s still hard to comprehend that we don’t need to fight for this any more.” She said her next campaign would be a new A-level in Ukrainian.
Gould said: “We’re just doing GCSEs for now. Let’s see how it goes. But we really want this to be a success.”

The minister said exams board had been nervous about developing a new qualification for a relatively small cohort of students. She said: “Despite the challenges of a smaller qualification, we really wanted to put financial resources to making it possible, and I’m grateful that AQA has come forward.
“I want this to happen as quickly as possible for people, but I’m really glad that it is happening now. Some of the students sitting here today will be able to study this GCSE.”

She encouraged British children to study for the new qualification as an act of solidarity. “I think it would be wonderful if more people were taking up Ukrainian GCSE,” she said, and she joked that Ukrainian children could tutor their friends as a “side hustle”.
When Gould announced the plan to a dozen Ukrainian pupils, they applauded and in unison said “diakuyemo”, or “thank you very much”.

articles.title: David Jones expected to fall into administration after failed 11th hour talks with biggest landlord
articles.author: Jonathan Barrett Business editor

paras.en: David Jones is poised to fall into administration after 11th-hour talks between its private equity owner and primary landlord broke down, putting the future of the 188-year-old upmarket department store chain at risk.
The upheaval follows years of steep losses, weak consumer spending and a string of underperforming stores that left the heritage retailer defaulting on its rent.
Its main landlord, Scentre Group, which owns Westfield, said discussions with David Jones’s owner, Anchorage Capital Partners, had ended without an agreement.
“They have not paid rent since September and therefore are in breach,” Scentre’s chief executive, Elliott Rusanow, said in a statement on Wednesday.
“We have made a generous offer to Anchorage Capital Partners that would have facilitated the continuation of David Jones trading and that offer has disappointingly been rejected by them.”
Two people with knowledge of the discussions but unauthorised to speak publicly said the next step was for administrators to be appointed.
While an administration process could help David Jones overhaul its business, it also takes the retailer’s fate out of its own hands, with the retailer subject to the competing claims of creditors.

Administrators would want to keep stores trading with little interruption through Black Friday and Christmas to capture the vital cash injection during those popular trading periods, one person briefed on the matter said.
Earlier on Wednesday, a David Jones spokesperson said its chief executive, Erica Berchtold, was in advanced discussions with key stakeholders.
“This includes a review of the portfolio of stores across Australia and the trading terms with suppliers and brand partners,” the spokesperson said in a statement.
The retailer was contacted for comment after Scentre confirmed that talks had ended.

David Jones had been seeking to renegotiate lease terms with its landlords and reduce its store numbers from the current 38, aiming to offload poor performing suburban sites, according to a person with knowledge of discussions.
Longer term, the retailer had wanted to reduce its network to about one-third of its current size.
While mid- to upmarket department stores have been struggling for years, the re-emergence of high inflation and the associated cost-of-living pressures has made trading conditions even worse.
Shares in Myer Holdings, operator of the rival Myer department store chain, are down more than 50% in 2026.
RMIT University advertising expert, Prof Robert Crawford, said David Jones had been caught in an intensifying squeeze between discount chains and luxury fashion houses that sell direct to consumers.
“The David Jones model has really struggled to adapt to modern retailing,” Crawford said.

articles.title: Kate McClymont questioned over ‘nail in the coffin’ and poo emoji texts at Alan Jones trial
articles.author: Amanda Meade Media correspondent

paras.en: Investigative journalist Kate McClymont has told a Sydney court that an audio recording in which she said new information would be “an absolute nail in the coffin” did not refer to “killing” Alan Jones.
paras.zh: 调查记者凯特·麦克利蒙（ Kate McClymont ）告诉悉尼一家法院，她说新信息“绝对是棺材中的钉子”的录音并没有提到“杀害”艾伦·琼斯（ Alan Jones ）。

paras.en: In a phone call with the mother of the youngest alleged victim of Jones, which was played in court, the Sydney Morning Herald’s chief investigative reporter expressed excitement when the woman said her son had spoken to police in the same year as the alleged assault.
paras.zh: 在与琼斯最年轻的据称受害者的母亲的电话中，悉尼先驱晨报的首席调查记者表示，当这名女子说她的儿子在被指控的袭击事件发生的同一年与警方交谈时，她感到兴奋。

paras.en: “This would be an absolute nail in the coffin that police were involved,” McClymont said in the call. “That’s just brilliant. Oh, I’m breathless.”
paras.zh: “这将是警方参与的棺材中的绝对钉子，”麦克利蒙在电话中说。“这真是太棒了。哦，我喘不过气来。”

paras.en: Asked by defence barrister Gabrielle Bashir SC if she meant it was a nail in the coffin of her client, McClymont said no.
paras.zh: 辩护律师加布里埃尔·巴希尔（ Gabrielle Bashir SC ）问她是否意味着这是她客户棺材上的一颗钉子，麦克利蒙特说不。

paras.en: “You meant the nail in the coffin of Alan Jones,” Bashir suggested.
paras.zh: “你是说艾伦·琼斯棺材里的钉子，”巴希尔建议。

paras.en: “It doesn’t mean killing Mr Jones,” she said. “It is the nail in the coffin for the story.”
paras.zh: “这并不意味着要杀死琼斯先生，”她说。“这是故事中棺材里的钉子。”

paras.en: The court heard last month that Jones allegedly put his tongue inside the mouth of the schoolboy, known as complainant A, and touched him on the bottom when he stayed overnight at the former 2GB broadcaster’s Fitzroy Falls farm.
paras.zh: 法院上个月获悉，琼斯据称将舌头插入被称为投诉人A的男学生的嘴里，并在前2GB广播公司的菲茨罗伊瀑布农场过夜时触摸了他的底部。

paras.en: “I felt violated and I felt gross,” the witness, who began corresponding with Jones as a 13-year-old, said in the witness box.
paras.zh: 这位目击者在证人席上说： “我觉得受到了侵犯，我觉得很恶心。”这位目击者在13岁时就开始与琼斯通信。

paras.en: A is one of five men who allege Jones indecently assaulted or sexually touched them between 2003 and 2020.
paras.zh: A是2003年至2020年期间指控琼斯猥亵或性接触他们的五名男子之一。

paras.en: Jones has pleaded not guilty to 21 counts of sexual touching and indecent assault.
paras.zh: 琼斯对21项性接触和猥亵罪表示不认罪。

paras.en: During her cross-examination, McClymont said “nail in the coffin” referred to new information gleaned from complainant A’s mother.
She said after she published her investigation into Jones in December 2023, police had told her “we have received no complaints about Alan Jones and we have not looked at him”.
But when she spoke to the mother she discovered that her son did speak to police and it was a “significant event” for the story.
The court heard McClymont was put in contact with the detective who had spoken to the-then teenager in the principal’s office at his school.

Bashir asked the journalist if she told the mother that both the NSW police minister’s office and the police sex crimes unit said that, should the case be re-opened, her son would not be identified because he was under 18.

The award-winning journalist agreed that she had sent A’s mother texts including: “All I wanted to say is Alan Jones is the subject of a police investigation!!!!” and “I hope the shit does hit the fan for him”, with two poo emojis.
The reporter agreed that she texted a contact from the police media team “Can hardly wait!” in reference to the impending arrest of Jones.
On the day of Jones’s arrest at his harbourside apartment in Circular Quay, McClymont texted her contact to clarify details, saying “beauty” when the arrest was confirmed.

The journalist agreed she provided a statement to police about Jones in June 2024 and continued to report because she had been given “no indication” that she would be a prosecution witness. She told the court she stopped reporting on the case when she was told she would be a witness at the trial.
McClymont will return to court on Thursday for a third day.
The trial before judge Glenn Walsh in the Downing Centre local court continues.

articles.title: US contractor gave Ethiopia secrets to help kill Tigray fighters

paras.en: An Ethiopian-born American citizen has pleaded guilty to passing highly classified intelligence to Ethiopia, including information he hoped would help target and kill fighters during the country's 2020 civil war.
paras.zh: 一名出生于埃塞俄比亚的美国公民承认向埃塞俄比亚传递了高度机密的情报，包括他希望有助于在该国2020年内战期间瞄准和杀死战斗人员的信息。

paras.en: Abraham Teklu Lemma, a former US contractor, admitted sharing dozens of classified documents and photographs with senior Ethiopian officials over more than two years, the US Department of Justice said.
paras.zh: 美国司法部表示，前美国承包商Abraham Teklu Lemma承认在两年多的时间里与埃塞俄比亚高级官员分享了数十份机密文件和照片。

paras.en: "In doing so, he betrayed his oath, his colleagues, and his country, while jeopardizing our national security," said US Attorney Jeanine Ferris Pirro.
paras.zh: “他这样做背叛了他的誓言、他的同事和他的国家，同时危及我们的国家安全，”美国检察官珍妮·费里斯·皮罗（ Jeanine Ferris Pirro ）说。

paras.en: The 54-year-old faces up to 22 years in prison under a plea agreement, with sentencing scheduled for next April.
paras.zh: 这名54岁的男子根据认罪协议面临长达22年的监禁，定于明年4月判刑。

paras.en: Abraham had worked as a contractor at the State Department, Justice Department and National Reconnaissance Office, the agency responsible for US intelligence satellites.
paras.zh: 亚伯拉罕曾在国务院、司法部和国家侦察办公室（负责美国情报卫星的机构）担任承包商。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Abraham worked with senior figures in Ethiopia's political, military and intelligence establishments between 2021 and his arrest in August 2023.
paras.zh: 检察官说，在2021年至2023年8月被捕期间，亚伯拉罕与埃塞俄比亚政治、军事和情报机构的高级官员合作。

paras.en: He secretly removed classified material from secure government facilities, sometimes copying sensitive information into handwritten notes that he carried out of the buildings. He used his position as an IT administrator to extract electronic intelligence files.
paras.zh: 他秘密地从安全的政府设施中取出机密材料，有时将敏感信息复制到他带出建筑物的手写笔记中。他利用自己作为IT管理员的职位提取电子情报文件。

paras.en: "Much of the highly classified information Lemma shared with the Ethiopian government concerned an armed conflict in Ethiopia," prosecutors said.
paras.zh: 检察官说： “Lemma与埃塞俄比亚政府分享的大部分高度机密信息都与埃塞俄比亚的武装冲突有关。”

paras.en: The information included satellite imagery and details of military activities, which he passed to Ethiopian officials through encrypted messages.
paras.zh: 这些信息包括卫星图像和军事活动的细节，他通过加密信息将其传递给埃塞俄比亚官员。

paras.en: The FBI said Ethiopian officials subsequently used intelligence supplied by Abraham in military operations.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局表示，埃塞俄比亚官员随后在军事行动中使用了亚伯拉罕提供的情报。

paras.en: Prosecutors said he hoped the information would help Ethiopia's military identify and kill paramilitary fighters.
paras.zh: 检察官说，他希望这些信息将有助于埃塞俄比亚军方识别和杀死准军事战斗人员。

paras.en: "Lemma betrayed the United States to an extraordinary degree," said John Eisenberg, the US assistant attorney general for national security.
paras.zh: 美国国家安全助理检察长约翰·艾森伯格（ John Eisenberg ）说： “Lemma在很大程度上背叛了美国。”

paras.en: In one message to an Ethiopian official in December 2021, he wrote: "We have to finish these people once and for all, otherwise there will never be peace in Ethiopia," court papers showed.
paras.zh: 法庭文件显示，在2021年12月给埃塞俄比亚官员的一封信中，他写道： “我们必须一劳永逸地结束这些人的生活，否则埃塞俄比亚永远不会有和平。”

paras.en: Later that day, he shared further intelligence and urged the official: "Please send Dro[nes]."
paras.zh: 当天晚些时候，他分享了进一步的情报，并敦促官员： “请发送Dro [nes]。”

paras.en: The revelations shed light on how sensitive American intelligence was passed to Ethiopian authorities during a devastating civil war that killed hundreds of thousands of people and displaced millions.
paras.zh: 这些启示揭示了在一场毁灭性的内战中，美国情报如何传递给埃塞俄比亚当局，这场内战造成数十万人死亡，数百万人流离失所。

paras.en: He was arrested in Maryland in August 2023 following an investigation into his handling of classified intelligence.
paras.zh: 在对他处理机密情报的调查后，他于2023年8月在马里兰州被捕。

paras.en: At the time, prosecutors alleged that had removed security markings from intelligence reports and shared information with a foreign intelligence official.
paras.zh: 当时，检察官声称已经从情报报告中删除了安全标记，并与一名外国情报官员分享了信息。

paras.en: In one exchange, the official asked him to continue providing assistance, to which Lemma replied: "Roger that!"
paras.zh: 在一次交流中，这位官员要求他继续提供帮助，莱玛回答说： “收到！”

paras.en: Pirro, the US attorney, said Abraham had abused his access to some of America's most sensitive intelligence.
paras.zh: 美国检察官皮罗说，亚伯拉罕滥用了他接触美国一些最敏感情报的机会。

paras.en: She accused him of betraying his colleagues and country with prosecutors saying he "will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law".
paras.zh: 她指责他背叛了他的同事和国家，检察官说他“将在法律的最大范围内被起诉”。

paras.en: Abraham pleaded guilty to conspiring to transmit national defence information to a foreign government.
paras.zh: 亚伯拉罕承认共谋将国防信息传递给外国政府。

paras.en: His sentencing is scheduled for 14 April 2027.
paras.zh: 他的判决定于2027年4月14日进行。

paras.en: The two-year conflict, which began in November 2020, pitted Ethiopian federal forces and their allies against fighters from the northern Tigray region.
paras.zh: 这场为期两年的冲突始于2020年11月，使埃塞俄比亚联邦部队及其盟友与提格雷北部地区的战斗人员发生冲突。

paras.en: It was marked by widespread allegations of atrocities, including massacres, sexual violence and attacks on civilians.
paras.zh: 其特点是普遍存在暴行指控，包括屠杀、性暴力和对平民的袭击。

paras.en: A peace agreement signed in November 2022 ended the main fighting, although tensions and insecurity have persisted.
paras.zh: 2022年11月签署的和平协议结束了主要战斗，尽管紧张局势和不安全状况持续存在。

articles.title: Ecstatic scenes and historic moments: What's happened so far in the midterms

paras.en: Democrats have won both the US Senate and House of Representatives, taking control of Congress for the rest of Donald Trump's presidency.
paras.zh: 民主党赢得了美国参议院和众议院，在唐纳德·特朗普总统任期的剩余时间里控制了国会。

paras.en: Even before results are finalised, the night has provided some historic results and scenes of celebration. These are some of the key moments so far.
paras.zh: 即使在结果最终确定之前，这个夜晚也提供了一些历史性的结果和庆祝的场景。这些是到目前为止的一些关键时刻。

paras.en: Democrats talk of 'great American comeback' after historic results
paras.zh: 在取得历史性成果后，民主党人谈论“伟大的美国复出”

paras.en: Democrats have tallied up victories in states that were comfortably won by Republican President Trump two years ago, registering sizeable swings in the likes of Texas, Kansas, Ohio and South Carolina.
paras.zh: 民主党人在两年前共和党总统特朗普轻松赢得的各州取得了胜利，在德克萨斯州、堪萨斯州、俄亥俄州和南卡罗来纳州等州取得了相当大的波动。

paras.en: Among the senior party figures who have cheered the results are Hakeem Jeffries, the top Democrat in the House of Representatives, who is now poised to take over as the speaker of the lower chamber of Congress.
paras.zh: 在为选举结果欢呼的高级党派人士中，有众议院最高民主党人哈基姆·杰弗里斯（ Hakeem Jeffries ） ，他现在准备接任国会下议院议长。

paras.en: "Today begins the great American comeback," he told a crowd of supporters.
paras.zh: “今天是美国伟大复出的开始，”他对一群支持者说。

paras.en: If Jeffries' colleagues choose to keep him as the leader of their party's delegation in House, he will be the next speaker, taking over from Republican Mike Jeffries.
paras.zh: 如果杰弗里斯的同事选择让他继续担任众议院党代表团团长，他将成为下一位发言人，接替共和党人迈克·杰弗里斯。

paras.en: Trump congratulates opposition on 'good job'
paras.zh: 特朗普祝贺反对派“干得好”

paras.en: Trump has spoken throughout the night to a number of media outlets, striking a conciliatory tone and conceding that the Democrats did a "good job".
paras.zh: 特朗普整夜向多家媒体发表讲话，表达了和解的语气，并承认民主党人做得“很好”。

paras.en: He said he would accept the results and that he was looking forward to working with the opposition party - albeit he would still have the power, as president, to veto legislation that Democrats advance through Texas.
paras.zh: 他说他会接受选举结果，并期待与反对党合作--尽管作为总统，他仍然有权否决民主党在德克萨斯州推进的立法。

paras.en: Trump distanced himself from some of the Republican candidates who contested the election, saying: "In some cases they didn't like the candidates, and in some cases those candidates were not my friend."
paras.zh: 特朗普与一些竞选的共和党候选人保持距离，他说： “在某些情况下，他们不喜欢这些候选人，在某些情况下，这些候选人不是我的朋友。”

paras.en: Cheers as Democrats win first Senate flip of the night in North Carolina
paras.zh: 欢呼民主党赢得北卡罗来纳州首个参议院之夜

paras.en: There were cheers from supporters in North Carolina as the Democrats secured the night's first flip of a Senate seat.
paras.zh: 北卡罗来纳州的支持者欢呼雀跃，因为民主党人获得了当晚参议院席位的第一次翻转。

paras.en: The state's former Democratic governor, Roy Cooper, won against Republican candidate Michael Whatley.
paras.zh: 该州前民主党州长罗伊·库珀（ Roy Cooper ）赢得了共和党候选人迈克尔·沃特利（ Michael What

paras.en: "Tonight we show the country that when everyday people come together, we can make change," Cooper said as he addressed his supporters on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 库珀周二在向支持者发表讲话时说： “今晚，我们向全国展示，当日常人聚集在一起时，我们可以做出改变。”

paras.en: The last time the Democrats won a Senate race in the state was 2008, despite the party making enormous investment in time and money behind their candidates in recent contests.
paras.zh: 民主党上一次赢得参议院竞选是在2008年，尽管该党在最近的竞选中投入了大量时间和金钱支持他们的候选人。

paras.en: Keisha Lance Bottoms becomes first black female governor
paras.zh: Keisha Lance Bottoms成为首位黑人女州长

paras.en: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms, the former mayor of Atlanta, has been projected to win the governor's race in Georgia, becoming the first black governor and first woman to be elected to the state's highest office.
paras.zh: 亚特兰大前市长、民主党人凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯（ Keisha Lance Bottoms ）预计将在佐治亚州赢得州长竞选，成为第一位当选该州最高职位的黑人州长和第一位女性。

paras.en: The BBC's Carl Nasman described ecstatic scenes as the race was projected blue, which came after the state's former senator said the party was "nauseously optimistic" about their chances this year.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司的卡尔·纳斯曼（ Carl Nasman ）描述了狂喜的场景，因为比赛被预测为蓝色，这是在该州前参议员表示该党对今年的机会“令人作呕地乐观”之后发生的。

paras.en: Bottoms defeated Republican Rick Jackson, a billionaire businessman and healthcare executive, who was endorsed by outgoing Governor Brian Kemp and President Trump, who spent $200 million of his own money on the race.
paras.zh: Bottoms击败了亿万富翁商人和医疗保健高管共和党人里克·杰克逊（ Rick Jackson ） ，后者得到了即将离任的州长布赖恩·坎普（ Brian Kemp ）和特朗普总统的支持，后者在竞选中花费了2亿美元。

paras.en: The state has also not had a Democratic governor in more than 20 years.
paras.zh: 该州已经有20多年没有民主党州长了。

paras.en: Ossoff victory in Georgia adds fuel to 2028 speculation
paras.zh: 奥索夫在格鲁吉亚的胜利为2028年的猜测增添了动力

paras.en: As well as Bottoms being elected the new governor of Georgia, Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff has been projected as the winner of the Senate race there, giving him a second term.
paras.zh: 除了Bottoms当选佐治亚州新州长外，民主党参议员乔恩·奥索夫（ Jon Ossoff ）预计将成为参议院竞选的胜利者，并获得第二个任期。

paras.en: His victory was not unexpected as he had a comfortable lead in the polls over his Republican challenger Mike Collins - a member of the lower House chamber.
paras.zh: 他的胜利并不出人意料，因为他在民意调查中领先于他的共和党挑战者迈克·柯林斯（ Mike Collins ） -下议院议员。

paras.en: Ossoff told his supporters following his victory that for those who "doubted whether our republic would survive" over the last two years, the "first light of dawn is on the horizon".
paras.zh: 奥索夫在获胜后告诉他的支持者，对于那些在过去两年中“怀疑我们的共和国是否能够生存”的人来说， “黎明的第一盏灯就在地平线上”。

paras.en: Republicans had hoped this would be a more competitive race because the Peach State has been reliably Republican for decades. Trump also won it in the 2024 presidential election, after Joe Biden eked out a narrow victory there in 2020.
paras.zh: 共和党人曾希望这将是一场更具竞争力的竞选，因为桃子州几十年来一直是可靠的共和党人。在乔·拜登（ Joe Biden ）于2020年在那里取得微弱胜利之后，特朗普在2024年的总统大选中也赢得了胜利。

paras.en: Now that he has won re-election in the Senate, the speculation surrounding Ossoff's plans for the next presidential election in 2028 will likely increase - he is considered a potential leading contender if he throws his hat in the ring.
paras.zh: 现在他赢得了参议院的连任，围绕奥索夫2028年下届总统大选计划的猜测可能会增加--如果他把帽子扔进拳击场，他将被认为是一个潜在的主要竞争者。

paras.en: Chris Pappas celebrates with husband as first openly gay man elected to Senate
paras.zh: 克里斯·帕帕斯（ Chris Pappas ）与丈夫一起庆祝成为首位当选参议员的公开同性恋

paras.en: Democrat Chris Pappas has also made history as the first openly gay man elected to the Senate. He celebrated on stage alongside his husband in New Hampshire.
paras.zh: 民主党人克里斯·帕帕斯（ Chris Pappas ）也创造了历史，成为第一位当选参议员的公开同性恋男子。他在新罕布什尔州与丈夫一起在舞台上庆祝。

paras.en: Pappas is projected to defeat former Republican Senator John Sununu in the race - who comes from one of the state's political dynasties having seen his father and brother serve as governor.
paras.zh: 帕帕斯预计将在竞选中击败前共和党参议员约翰·苏努努（ John Sununu ） ，他来自该州的一个政治王朝，曾见过他的父亲和兄弟担任州长。

paras.en: But the contest between the two was well-natured, with Pappas thanking his opponent on Tuesday by saying: "We all owe John Sununu a big debt of gratitude for his public service for the people of New Hampshire."
paras.zh: 但两人之间的比赛是善意的，帕帕斯周二感谢他的对手说： “我们都欠约翰·苏努努（ John Sununu ）一大笔钱，感谢他为新罕布什尔州人民提供的公共服务。”

paras.en: The 46-year-old Pappas had represented New Hampshire in the House since 2019 but chose not to run for re-election so he could launch his campaign for the Senate.
paras.zh: 这位46岁的帕帕斯自2019年以来一直在众议院代表新罕布什尔州，但他选择不竞选连任，以便他可以发起参议院竞选活动。

articles.title: Anthony Zurcher: Democrats tear up Trump's political map on historic night

paras.en: Democrats have torn up Donald Trump's political map on a night that will send shockwaves through American politics for years to come.
paras.zh: 民主党人已经撕毁了唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)的政治地图，这将在未来几年给美国政治带来冲击。

paras.en: With a string of major Senate victories in states that have been reliably Republican for decades - and in Kansas's case, nearly a century - a blue tidal wave crashed across the nation, sweeping Republicans out of power.
paras.zh: 参议院在几十年来一直是共和党人的各州取得了一系列重大胜利--堪萨斯州的情况是近一个世纪--一股蓝色的浪潮席卷全国，将共和党人赶下台。

paras.en: Halfway through President Donald Trump's second term, the Democrats now have decisive control of the House of Representatives and have wrested a majority back in the Senate.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统第二个任期的中途，民主党现在对众议院拥有决定性的控制权，并在参议院夺回了多数席位。

paras.en: They will be able to frustrate Trump's agenda, and launch investigations into his administration. A historic third impeachment attempt could also be on the cards.
paras.zh: 他们将能够挫败特朗普的议程，并对他的政府展开调查。历史性的第三次弹劾尝试也可能会出现。

paras.en: Few imagined such an outcome was possible in the months after Trump returned to the White House with unified Republican control of Congress in January 2025.
paras.zh: 很少有人想到，在特朗普于2025年1月以共和党对国会的统一控制权重返白宫后的几个月里，这样的结果是可能的。

paras.en: As the public mood turned against him and his party, Democrats had hopes of retaking the House.
paras.zh: 随着公众情绪转向反对他和他的政党，民主党人希望重新夺回众议院。

paras.en: But they contemplated a Senate map that appeared unfriendly, populated by states Trump had won comfortably just two years ago.
paras.zh: 但他们考虑了参议院地图，该地图看起来不友好，特朗普两年前刚刚赢得胜利。

paras.en: Instead, Democrats rewrote the political equations with victories in Texas, Maine, Kansas, Ohio, Iowa and North and South Carolina.
paras.zh: 相反，民主党以德克萨斯州、缅因州、堪萨斯州、俄亥俄州、爱荷华州以及北卡罗来纳州和南卡罗来纳州的胜利重写了政治方程式。

paras.en: In comments to the BBC's US partner CBS, Trump pledged to strike deals with congressional Democrats, adding that he didn't want to have to spend his final two years in office rejecting their legislation.
paras.zh: 在对英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（ CBS ）的评论中，特朗普承诺与国会民主党人达成协议，并补充说，他不想在执政的最后两年里拒绝他们的立法。

paras.en: He somewhat undermined that sentiment later, posting a picture to Truth Social of his trademark red baseball hat with the word "veto" emblazoned on it.
paras.zh: 后来，他在Truth Social上张贴了一张他标志性的红色棒球帽的照片，上面印有“否决权”一词。

paras.en: The president went on to note that his name wasn't on the ballot this year, but if it had been Republicans would have won a decisive victory.
paras.zh: 总统接着指出，今年的选票上没有他的名字，但如果是共和党人，他会赢得决定性的胜利。

paras.en: Trump had helped elevate many of those Republican candidates, however, and had urged voters to pretend he was up for re-election.
paras.zh: 然而，特朗普帮助提升了许多共和党候选人，并敦促选民假装他准备连任。

paras.en: In the Senate, Democrats flipped at least six seats, comfortably securing a majority.
paras.zh: 在参议院，民主党至少翻转了六个席位，轻松地获得了多数席位。

paras.en: Adam Hamilton won Kansas' Senate seat - a state that last elected a Democrat to the Senate almost 100 years ago during the Great Depression.
paras.zh: 亚当·汉密尔顿（ Adam Hamilton ）赢得了堪萨斯州的参议院席位，该州在近100年前的大萧条时期最后一次选举民主党人进入参议院。

paras.en: James Talarico beat Republican Ken Paxton in Texas' Senate race, ending a 38-year Democratic losing streak in statewide elections there.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·塔拉里科（ James Talarico ）在德克萨斯州参议院竞选中击败了共和党人肯·帕克斯顿（ Ken Paxton ） ，结束了民主党

paras.en: In South Carolina, Annie Andrews beat Darline Graham, who had been appointed to the seat after the death of her brother, Senator Lindsey Graham. Few analysts had that seat in play even a few months ago.
paras.zh: 在南卡罗来纳州，安妮·安德鲁斯（ Annie Andrews ）击败了达琳·格雷厄姆（ Darline Graham ） ，后者在她的兄弟参议员林赛·格雷厄姆（ Lindse甚至在几个月前，很少有分析师拥有这样的席位。

paras.en: Five-term Republican Susan Collins conceded Maine's Senate election to Democrat Troy Jackson.
paras.zh: 五届共和党人苏珊·柯林斯（ Susan Collins ）将缅因州的参议院选举让给了民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊

paras.en: Paralympian Josh Turek flipped the Iowa Senate seat held by retiring Republican Senator Joni Ernst. Democrats also wrested from Republicans a Senate seat in Ohio, with Sherrod Brown's comeback victory over Jon Husted.
paras.zh: 残奥会选手乔希·图雷克（ Josh Turek ）改变了即将退休的共和党参议员乔尼·恩斯特（ Joni Ernst ）在爱荷华州参议院的席民主党人还从共和党人手中夺取了俄亥俄州的参议院席位，谢罗德·布朗（ Sherrod Brown ）战胜了乔恩·哈斯特德（ Jon Husted ）

paras.en: Meanwhile, Democrat Abdul El-Sayed looked on course to beat Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan's bitterly fought Senate race.
paras.zh: 与此同时，民主党人阿卜杜勒·赛义德（ Abdul El-Sayed ）希望在密歇根州激烈的参议院竞选中击败共和党人迈克·罗杰斯（ Mike Rogers ）。

paras.en: Nor was that the end of the electoral carnage for Republicans.
paras.zh: 这也不是共和党大屠杀的结束。

paras.en: Ruby-red Texas witnessed another seismic result in the governor's race.
paras.zh: 红宝石德克萨斯州目睹了州长竞选的另一个地震结果。

paras.en: Democratic challenger Gina Hinojosa ousted the incumbent Republican Greg Abbott, who was earlier this year seen as the prohibitive favourite.
paras.zh: 民主党挑战者吉娜·伊诺霍萨（ Gina Hinojosa ）推翻了现任共和党人格雷格·阿博特（ Greg Abbott ） ，后者在今年早些时候被视为令人望而却步的

paras.en: Democrats also took governors' races in Iowa, Ohio and Georgia, which made history by electing the first black woman to such a post.
paras.zh: 民主党人还参加了爱荷华州、俄亥俄州和佐治亚州的州长竞选，通过选出第一位黑人女性来创造历史。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the party has won a House majority for the first time since 2022.
paras.zh: 与此同时，该党自2022年以来首次赢得众议院多数席位。

paras.en: They are projected to win at 244 House seats and the Republicans 165 seats.
paras.zh: 他们预计将赢得244个众议院席位和165个共和党席位。

paras.en: A look at the key races offers plenty of reasons why.
paras.zh: 看一下关键比赛有很多原因。

paras.en: Democrats flipped House seats in Texas, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Iowa, Kentucky and Colorado, among others. And they were poised to make gains in Virginia and Indiana.
paras.zh: 民主党人在德克萨斯州、北卡罗来纳州、宾夕法尼亚州、爱荷华州、肯塔基州和科罗拉多州等地推翻了众议院席位。他们准备在弗吉尼亚州和印第安纳州取得进展。

paras.en: Black Democrats in the southern states turned out in record number, helping to carry their party to victory. And Hispanic voters, whose support had helped secure Trump's presidential victory in 2024, swung decisively back to the Democrats.
paras.zh: 南部各州的黑人民主党人数创下纪录，帮助他们的政党取得了胜利。西班牙裔选民的支持有助于确保特朗普在2024年赢得总统大选，他们果断地转向民主党。

paras.en: Democrats won all three House races in the overwhelmingly Hispanic congressional districts along the Texas-Mexico border.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州-墨西哥边境沿线的绝大多数西班牙裔国会选区，民主党赢得了所有三场众议院竞选。

paras.en: And Hispanic voters helped Democrats hold House seats in Florida that the state's Republicans had sought to flip by redrawing the congressional district lines.
paras.zh: 西班牙裔选民帮助民主党人在佛罗里达州获得众议院席位，该州的共和党人试图通过重新划定国会选区的界限来翻转众议院席位。

paras.en: In fact, the congressional redistricting battles that had dominated headlines for months last year ended up being a bust for the Republicans.
paras.zh: 事实上，去年几个月来占据头条新闻的国会重新划分选区的斗争最终成为共和党人的失败。

paras.en: In Texas, they had hoped their line-drawing would net five new seats for their party. But on Tuesday they may end up losing one seat.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，他们曾希望他们的划线将为他们的政党赢得五个新席位。但在周二，他们可能会失去一个席位。

paras.en: If there is a silver lining for conservatives, Florida as a whole still appears to tilt to the right.
paras.zh: 如果保守派有一线希望，那么佛罗里达州作为一个整体似乎仍然向右倾斜。

paras.en: Republican Senator Ashley Moody narrowly won re-election, as did congressman Byron Donalds, who was elected the Sunshine State's first black governor.
paras.zh: 共和党参议员阿什利·穆迪（ Ashley Moody ）以微弱优势赢得了连任，当选阳光州第一位黑人州长的国会议员拜伦·唐纳兹（ Byron Donalds ）也是如此。

paras.en: And embattled Republicans were able to hold governorships in Vermont and New Hampshire. But the bright spots were few and far between.
paras.zh: 陷入困境的共和党人能够在佛蒙特州和新罕布什尔州担任州长。但亮点很少，而且相距甚远。

paras.en: Just two years ago, Trump won the presidency with 48% of the vote. He claimed an electoral mandate.
paras.zh: 就在两年前，特朗普以48%的选票赢得总统大选。他声称获得了选举授权。

paras.en: He then went about governing like it, pushing sometimes unpopular policies on trade and immigration, and launching an Iran war that is opposed by most of the American public.
paras.zh: 然后，他开始像这样执政，有时在贸易和移民方面推行不受欢迎的政策，并发动了一场遭到大多数美国公众反对的伊朗战争。

paras.en: On Tuesday, voters gave him the kind of stinging rebuke that will not be easily forgotten.
paras.zh: 周二，选民给了他一种不容易忘记的尖锐指责。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extended Life，或EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: Carlisle 的 EL121 系列盘式刹车片现已通过 Carlisle 授权经销商和分销商发售。要了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的卡莱尔授权经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表 https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle 发布 Ag 视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了提高可视化效果，该视频采用 3D 动画和标准拖拉机模型中的产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Autel Partners with ALLDATA to Connect MaxiSYS Diagnostics with OEM Repair Information
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Autel U.S. has partnered with ALLDATA, a leading provider of original OEM repair information, to connect Autel’s MaxiSYS diagnostic software with ALLDATA Repair on MaxiSYS Ultra S2 and Ultra series tablets. This integration enables technicians to move directly from a vehicle fault code to the corresponding OEM diagnostic information, bringing scan results and OEM procedures together on one screen.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 与原始 OEM 维修信息的领先提供商 ALLDATA 合作，将 Autel 的 MaxiSYS 诊断软件与 MaxiSYS Ultra S2 和 Ultra 系列平板电脑上的 ALLDATA Repair 连接起来。这种集成使技术人员能够直接从车辆故障代码转移到相应的 OEM 诊断信息，将扫描结果和 OEM 程序集中在一个屏幕上。

paras.en: Supported models include the MaxiSYS Ultra S2, MS919 S2 and MS909 S2, as well as the MaxiSYS Ultra, MS919, MS909, Ultra ADAS and Ultra EV.
paras.zh: 支持的型号包括 MaxiSYS Ultra S2、MS919 S2 和 MS909 S2，以及 MaxiSYS Ultra、MS919、MS909、Ultra ADAS 和 Ultra EV。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 400,000 technicians, ALLDATA provides access to original diagnostic and repair information supplied by vehicle manufacturers. ALLDATA Repair covers more than 44,000 engine-specific vehicles, representing approximately 95% of vehicles on the road. It includes OEM repair procedures, diagnostic flow charts, technical service bulletins, component locations, specifications and wiring diagrams.
paras.zh: ALLDATA 受到超过 400,000 名技术人员的信赖，提供对汽车制造商提供的原始诊断和维修信息的访问。 ALLDATA Repair 覆盖超过 44,000 辆发动机专用车辆，约占道路上车辆的 95%。它包括 OEM 维修程序、诊断流程图、技术服务公告、组件位置、规格和接线图。

paras.en: “Our partnership with Autel is another step toward creating a more connected diagnostic experience for technicians, when vehicles complexity is increasing,” said Satwinder Mangat, president of ALLDATA. “Bringing ALLDATA’s trusted OEM repair information into the diagnostic workflow helps technicians access the OEM information they need when and where they need it.”
paras.zh: ALLDATA 总裁 Satwinder Mangat 表示：“当车辆复杂性不断增加时，我们与 Autel 的合作是朝着为技术人员创造更加互联的诊断体验迈出的又一步。” “将 ALLDATA 值得信赖的 OEM 维修信息引入诊断工作流程可帮助技术人员随时随地访问所需的 OEM 信息。”

paras.en: Diagnostics and ALLDATA Repair Info. One Screen. Right at the Vehicle
paras.zh: 诊断和 ALLDATA 修复信息。一屏。就在车辆旁边

paras.en: The integration connects this extensive information resource with Autel’s diagnostic capabilities where technicians need it. From a fault code displayed in MaxiSYS, users can open the associated ALLDATA information for the selected vehicle and review OEM code descriptions, detection criteria, possible causes and diagnostic procedures. A split-screen view keeps the MaxiSYS diagnostic results visible alongside ALLDATA, allowing technicians to consult factory instructions without losing sight of the fault they are investigating.
paras.zh: 该集成将这种广泛的信息资源与技术人员需要的 Autel 诊断功能连接起来。从 MaxiSYS 中显示的故障代码中，用户可以打开所选车辆的相关 ALLDATA 信息，并查看 OEM 代码描述、检测标准、可能的原因和诊断程序。分屏视图使 MaxiSYS 诊断结果与 ALLDATA 一起可见，使技术人员能够查阅工厂说明，而不会忽视他们正在调查的故障。

paras.en: Technicians can then follow links within ALLDATA to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions. By carrying the vehicle and fault-code context into the repair information workflow, the integration reduces the need to search separately for the same vehicle and code. It helps technicians move more efficiently from diagnosis to repair. The integration also provides access to ALLDATA Diagnostic Intelligence, ALLDATA’s newest solution, combining OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow.
paras.zh: 然后，技术人员可以通过 ALLDATA 内的链接查看相关测试、拆卸和安装程序、插图和维修预防措施。通过将车辆和故障代码上下文纳入维修信息工作流程，集成减少了单独搜索相同车辆和代码的需要。它可以帮助技术人员更有效地从诊断到维修。该集成还提供对 ALLDATA 诊断智能的访问，这是 ALLDATA 的最新解决方案，它将 OEM 维修信息、实际维修智能和人工智能辅助见解结合在一个诊断工作流程中。

paras.en: “Finding a fault code is only the beginning. The next step is knowing how to test the system, identify the cause and perform the repair correctly,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S. “Connecting MaxiSYS diagnostics with ALLDATA’s OEM repair information gives technicians a direct path to those answers, right on the tablet they are already using at the vehicle.”
paras.zh: Autel 美国首席执行官 Chloe Hung 表示：“查找故障代码只是开始。下一步是了解如何测试系统、确定原因并正确执行维修。将 MaxiSYS 诊断与 ALLDATA 的 OEM 维修信息连接起来，技术人员可以直接在车辆上使用的平板电脑上找到这些答案。”
