articles.title: Niterra President and CEO Mike Schwab on ‘Delivering Trusted Solutions’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Mike Schwab, president and CEO of Niterra North America, Inc.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 Niterra North America, Inc. 的总裁兼首席执行官 Mike Schwab。

paras.en: Schwab said Niterra has evolved well beyond its roots as an ignition specialist while maintaining the quality and reliability associated with its NGK brand. Today, Niterra’s automotive portfolio extends beyond spark plugs to include ignition coils, wire sets, NTK oxygen and technical sensors and rotating electrical products such as starters and alternators.
paras.zh: Schwab 表示，Niterra 已经远远超越了其作为点火专家的根源，同时保持了 NGK 品牌相关的质量和可靠性。如今，Niterra 的汽车产品组合已不仅仅局限于火花塞，还包括点火线圈、电线组、NTK 氧气和技术传感器以及起动机和交流发电机等旋转电气产品。

paras.en: Schwab emphasized that quality, integrity, teamwork and consistent execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy, even as the industry evolves. These principles, he says, guide how the company serves customers, from delivering dependable products and maintaining transparency to strengthening partnerships and addressing customer challenges. Schwab emphasized that execution means consistently delivering on commitments involving product availability, customer service and new product introductions. While technology and product offerings will continue to change, he believes trust, reliability and strong customer relationships will remain essential to the company’s long-term success.
paras.zh: Schwab 强调，即使行业不断发展，质量、诚信、团队合作和一致执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础。他说，这些原则指导公司如何服务客户，从提供可靠的产品和保持透明度到加强合作伙伴关系和应对客户挑战。施瓦布强调，执行意味着始终如一地兑现涉及产品可用性、客户服务和新产品推出的承诺。尽管技术和产品供应将不断变化，但他相信信任、可靠性和强大的客户关系对于公司的长期成功仍然至关重要。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Schwab said the transition from NGK Spark Plug to Niterra represents a broader transformation rather than simply a name change. While continuing to strengthen its automotive business, the company is pursuing growth in new products, technologies and markets that build on its engineering capabilities. Opportunities in advanced mobility, electric vehicles and other emerging technologies are part of that strategy. Schwab said the Niterra name, derived from Latin words meaning “to shine” and “Earth,” reflects the company’s ambition to contribute to a more sustainable future.
paras.zh: 展望未来，Schwab 表示，从 NGK Spark Plug 到 Niterra 的转变代表着更广泛的转变，而不仅仅是名称更改。在继续加强汽车业务的同时，该公司正在以其工程能力为基础，寻求新产品、技术和市场的增长。先进移动、电动汽车和其他新兴技术的机会是该战略的一部分。施瓦布表示，Niterra 这个名字源自拉丁语，意思是“闪耀”和“地球”，反映了该公司为更加可持续的未来做出贡献的雄心。

paras.en: To hear more of Schwab’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解更多施瓦布的见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.en: - How Niterra is expanding beyond spark plugs with a broader portfolio of ignition, sensor and rotating electrical products. (4:49)
paras.zh: - Niterra 如何超越火花塞，推出更广泛的点火、传感器和旋转电气产品组合。 （4:49）

paras.en: - Quality, integrity, teamwork and execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy and help strengthen customer relationships and deliver value. (6:17)
paras.zh: - 质量、诚信、团队合作和执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础，有助于加强客户关系并创造价值。 （6:17）

paras.en: - Niterra emphasizes a people-first approach to serving the industry and what that commitment looks like in practice for customers, employees and partners. (9:14)
paras.zh: - Niterra 强调以人为本的方法来服务行业，以及这种承诺在实践中对客户、员工和合作伙伴的影响。 （9:14）

paras.en: - How the Niterra name reflects the company’s evolution and future growth opportunities in advanced mobility and new technologies. (11:06)
paras.zh: - Niterra 名称如何反映公司在先进移动性和新技术方面的发展和未来增长机会。 (11:06)

paras.en: - The story behind Niterra’s name and the employee-driven process that helped create it. (13:23)
paras.zh: - Niterra 名称背后的故事以及帮助创建它的员工驱动流程。 (13:23)

paras.en: - Lightning Round: Schwab shares some personal insights. (14:59)
paras.zh: - 闪电轮：施瓦布分享了一些个人见解。 (14:59)

articles.title: MEYLE German License Plate Fundraiser to Return to AAPEX
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: MEYLE announced that it will bring its German license plate fundraiser to raise money for Northwood University scholarships back to AAPEX 2026 (Nov. 3-5 in Las Vegas).
paras.zh: MEYLE 宣布将在 AAPEX 2026（11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯）举行德国车牌筹款活动，为诺斯伍德大学奖学金筹集资金。

paras.en: MEYLE will host the fundraiser at its exhibit at the show, featuring a German license plate stamping machine. Visitors can create custom MEYLE-branded plates in exchange for donations benefiting Northwood students.
paras.zh: MEYLE 将在展会上的展位上举办筹款活动，展出一台德国车牌冲压机。参观者可以制作定制的 MEYLE 品牌盘子，以换取惠及诺斯伍德学生的捐款。

paras.en: Last year’s initiative generated $9,171 in donations. MEYLE supplemented that amount with a $5,000 matching contribution, bringing the total to $14,171.
paras.zh: 去年的倡议筹集了 9,171 美元的捐款。 MEYLE 补充了 5,000 美元的配套捐款，使总额达到 14,171 美元。

paras.en: Northwood Student Receives First MEYLE Scholarship
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德学生获得首届梅尔奖学金

paras.en: Earlier this year, Quinn Balcam became the first recipient of the MEYLE scholarship. Balcam, an automotive aftermarket management major from Bloomington, Indiana, serves as president of Northwood’s student aftermarket club.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，Quinn Balcam 成为第一位获得 MEYLE 奖学金的人。巴尔卡姆是来自印第安纳州布卢明顿的汽车售后市场管理专业学生，担任诺斯伍德学生售后市场俱乐部的主席。

paras.en: MEYLE notes that Balcam has demonstrated his industry commitment through multiple internships and leadership in the Northwood University International Auto Show’s aftermarket division. He has also participated in events including AAPEX, SEMA and Heavy-Duty Aftermarket Week.
paras.zh: MEYLE 指出，Balcam 通过在诺斯伍德大学国际汽车展售后市场部门的多次实习和领导，展示了他的行业承诺。他还参加了 AAPEX、SEMA 和重型售后市场周等活动。

paras.en: “Seeing the funds raised at AAPEX translate into scholarship support for a student like Quinn illustrates why partnerships like this are so important,” said James O’Dell, director of aftermarket education at Northwood University. “The automotive aftermarket needs talented, motivated young professionals, and MEYLE is helping our students gain both the financial support and industry connections they need to succeed.”
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德大学售后教育总监詹姆斯·奥戴尔 (James O'Dell) 表示：“看到 AAPEX 筹集的资金转化为对 Quinn 这样的学生的奖学金支持，这说明了为什么这样的合作伙伴关系如此重要。” “汽车售后市场需要有才华、积极进取的年轻专业人士，MEYLE 正在帮助我们的学生获得成功所需的财务支持和行业联系。”

articles.title: Don’t Forget Lubrication During an Oil Change
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Back in my day at the service station, when a customer came in for an oil change, they pulled it into a grease pit and we would grease up everything on the vehicle—ball joints, universal joints, and then we would do the oil changes. Today, it’s different. Vehicles are a lot more low maintenance.
paras.zh: 回到我在服务站的日子，当客户来换油时，他们把它拉进油坑，我们会给车辆上的所有东西涂上油脂——球节、万向节，然后我们会换油。今天，情况有所不同。车辆的维护费用要低得多。

paras.en: However, the aftermarket has not abandoned the message that lubrication is required for certain repair components to make that repair just that much better. In other words, we have ball joints that have grease nipples that need to be lubricated every so often, like during an oil change. It’s also written in the vehicle service information that doors and lift hatches need to be lubricated every so often.
paras.zh: 然而，售后市场并没有放弃这样的信息：某些维修部件需要润滑才能使维修效果更好。换句话说，我们的球窝接头带有油嘴，需要经常润滑，例如在换油期间。车辆服务信息中还写明，车门和电梯舱口需要经常润滑。

paras.en: Your shop probably has an oil change and you probably call it an LOF. So let’s put that L back in LOF: lubrication, oil, filter.
paras.zh: 您的商店可能需要更换机油，您可能称其为 LOF。所以让我们把 L 放回 LOF：润滑、机油、过滤器。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by Auto Value and Bumper To Bumper.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Auto Value 和 Bumper To Bumper 赞助。

articles.title: Autel Awards Five Automotive Education Scholarships
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel announced five recipients of its second annual Awarding Excellence Scholarships. The scholarships are part of Autel Cares, the company’s philanthropic initiative supporting automotive education and community causes.
paras.zh: Autel 宣布了第二届年度卓越奖学金的五名获得者。这些奖学金是 Autel Cares 的一部分，这是该公司支持汽车教育和社区事业的慈善计划。

paras.en: The 2026 program awards five $5,000 scholarships, totaling $25,000. The awards support students pursuing education and training in automotive repair and service.
paras.zh: 2026 年计划颁发五项 5,000 美元的奖学金，总计 25,000 美元。该奖项支持学生接受汽车维修和服务方面的教育和培训。

paras.en: Recipients can use the scholarships for tuition, tools, books, supplies and other education-related expenses. The students are preparing for careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 获奖者可以使用奖学金支付学费、工具、书籍、用品和其他与教育相关的费用。学生们正在为汽车维修行业的职业生涯做准备。

paras.en: This year, Autel expanded eligibility beyond recent high school graduates. Adult learners returning to school or transitioning from another career also qualified.
paras.zh: 今年，Autel 将资格范围扩大到刚毕业的高中毕业生。返回学校或从其他职业转型的成人学习者也符合资格。

paras.en: The 2026 recipients represent students at different stages of life and training. Their interests include automotive technology, collision repair, manufacturer-level service and automotive cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 2026 名获奖者代表了处于人生和培训不同阶段的学生。他们的兴趣包括汽车技术、碰撞修复、制造商级服务和汽车网络安全。

paras.en: “Last year, selecting our first scholarship recipients was difficult. This year was even more challenging because we received so many outstanding applications from students with compelling stories, clear goals, and a genuine commitment to automotive education,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S.
paras.zh: Autel 美国首席执行官 Chloe Hung 表示：“去年，选择第一批奖学金获得者非常困难。今年更具挑战性，因为我们收到了许多来自学生的优秀申请，这些学生拥有引人入胜的故事、明确的目标以及对汽车教育的真诚承诺。”

paras.en: “The five recipients selected this year reflect the many different paths people take into the automotive repair industry, from students beginning their training to adults continuing or returning to school. Autel is proud to support their education and invest in the skilled professionals who will help shape the future of automotive repair.”
paras.zh: “今年选出的五位获奖者反映了人们进入汽车维修行业的多种不同途径，从学生开始接受培训到成人继续或返回学校。Autel 很自豪能够支持他们的教育并投资于有助于塑造汽车维修未来的熟练专业人员。”

paras.en: The 2026 Autel Awarding Excellence Scholarship recipients are:
paras.zh: 2026 年 Autel 卓越奖学金获得者是：

paras.en: - Shawn Clark, of Deer Lodge, Montana, attends Highlands College of Montana Tech. Clark is beginning a new chapter in automotive education at age 50. He is pursuing an associate degree in automotive technology. His application reflects this year’s expanded eligibility for adult learners returning to school. Clark plans to build a new career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - 蒙大拿州 Deer Lodge 的 Shawn Clark 就读于蒙大拿州高地理工学院。 50 岁时，克拉克开始了汽车教育的新篇章。他正在攻读汽车技术副学士学位。他的申请反映了今年成人学习者重返校园的资格扩大了。克拉克计划在汽车维修领域开创新的职业生涯。

paras.en: - Jacob Heinrichs, of Austin, Texas, attends Universal Technical Institute of Texas Inc. Heinrichs already works in the field and has three years of experience as an automotive technician. His selection reflects Autel’s support for working technicians seeking additional training. Heinrichs aims to advance his skills and career opportunities.
paras.zh: - Jacob Heinrichs 来自德克萨斯州奥斯汀，就读于德克萨斯州通用技术学院。Heinrichs 已经在该领域工作，并拥有三年的汽车技术人员经验。他的选择反映了 Autel 对寻求额外培训的工作技术人员的支持。海因里希斯的目标是提高他的技能和职业机会。

paras.en: - Marisa Rueger, of Harleysville, Pennsylvania, attends Automotive Training Center-Warminster. Rueger is pursuing collision repair and holds a 4.0 GPA. In her application, she described collision repair as her art. She also emphasized her desire to continue learning, growing and succeeding in the field.
paras.zh: - 来自宾夕法尼亚州哈利斯维尔的 Marisa Rueger 就读于沃明斯特汽车培训中心。 Rueger 致力于碰撞修复并拥有 4.0 GPA。在她的申请中，她将碰撞修复描述为她的艺术。她还强调了她在该领域继续学习、成长和取得成功的愿望。

paras.en: - Logan Mercier, of Claremont, California, attends Universal Technical Institute of California Inc. Mercier aims to complete school with a 4.0 GPA. He also plans to build advanced diagnostic skills and work toward becoming a master technician. His application focuses on academic achievement, professional growth and building a career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - Logan Mercier，来自加利福尼亚州克莱蒙特，就读于加州环球技术学院。Mercier 的目标是以 4.0 的 GPA 完成学业。他还计划培养先进的诊断技能，并努力成为一名技术大师。他的申请重点是学术成就、专业发展和在汽车维修领域建立职业生涯。

paras.en: - Kristof Adam, of Stillwater, Minnesota, attends Century College. Adam is pursuing a career in automotive cybersecurity. He has a strong interest in hands-on vehicle work and advanced automotive technology. His application highlights the growing importance of technical education as vehicles become more connected, complex and software-driven.
paras.zh: - 明尼苏达州斯蒂尔沃特的克里斯托夫·亚当 (Kristof Adam) 就读于世纪学院。 Adam 正在从事汽车网络安全领域的职业。他对车辆实践和先进汽车技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他的申请凸显了随着车辆变得更加互联、复杂和软件驱动，技术教育变得越来越重要。

paras.en: Applicants submitted either a 500- to 600-word essay or a two- to three-minute video. They described the path that led them to pursue automotive repair education.
paras.zh: 申请人提交了一篇 500 到 600 字的论文或一段两到三分钟的视频。他们描述了引导他们追求汽车维修教育的道路。

paras.en: Applicants also explained how the scholarship would support their training. They discussed their goals, obstacles and planned careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 申请人还解释了奖学金将如何支持他们的培训。他们讨论了自己在汽车维修行业的目标、障碍和职业规划。

articles.title: TotalEnergies, SSF Announce ELF Oil Distribution Agreement
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: TotalEnergies Marketing USA Inc. and SSF Imported Auto Parts announced a U.S. distribution agreement for ELF passenger car motor oils. Under the agreement, SSF will distribute ELF products through its 13 distribution centers nationwide.
paras.zh: TotalEnergies Marketing USA Inc. 和 SSF Imported Auto Parts 宣布签署 ELF 乘用车机油美国分销协议。根据协议，SSF将通过其全国13个分销中心分销ELF产品。

paras.en: The partnership expands access to ELF lubricants for automotive professionals and enthusiasts across the United States. It combines ELF’s motorsports heritage, European engineering expertise and original equipment manufacturer (OEM)-approved technology with SSF’s distribution network. The companies aim to provide engine oils that meet the demands of modern passenger vehicles.
paras.zh: 此次合作扩大了美国各地汽车专业人士和爱好者对 ELF 润滑油的使用范围。它将 ELF 的赛车运动传统、欧洲工程专业知识和原始设备制造商 (OEM) 批准的技术与 SSF 的分销网络相结合。两家公司的目标是提供满足现代乘用车需求的发动机油。

paras.en: TotalEnergies Expands ELF Distribution Through SSF
paras.zh: TotalEnergies 通过 SSF 扩大 ELF 分销

paras.en: ELF originated in France in 1967 and has a long history in automotive lubricants and motorsports. The brand has recorded 156 Grand Prix victories, 10 driver titles and nine manufacturer titles. In motorcycle racing, ELF has achieved 33 MotoGP victories and two world championship titles.
paras.zh: ELF于1967年起源于法国，在汽车润滑油和赛车运动领域拥有悠久的历史。该品牌已获得 156 场大奖赛胜利、10 项车手冠军和 9 项制造商冠军。在摩托车比赛中，ELF已经取得了33场MotoGP胜利和两次世界冠军头衔。

paras.en: ELF has collaborated with Alpine, Renault, Nissan, Kawasaki and Dacia. The brand offers specialized lubricants for cars and motorcycles in more than 110 countries.
paras.zh: ELF 已与阿尔派、雷诺、日产、川崎和达西亚合作。该品牌为 110 多个国家/地区的汽车和摩托车提供专用润滑油。

paras.en: Company Executives Discuss Distribution Agreement
paras.zh: 公司高管讨论分销协议

paras.en: “We are excited to partner with SSF Imported Auto Parts to accelerate the growth of ELF across the United States,” said Rod Umphreys, commercial director at TotalEnergies Marketing USA. “SSF has built an outstanding reputation for serving the import automotive market with premium products and exceptional customer support. Their expertise and national distribution capabilities make them the ideal partner to bring ELF’s passion, European technology, OEM-approved formulations, and motorsports-inspired performance to more drivers and repair professionals throughout the country.”
paras.zh: TotalEnergies Marketing USA 商务总监 Rod Umphreys 表示：“我们很高兴与 SSF Imported Auto Parts 合作，加速 ELF 在美国的发展。” “SSF 在为进口汽车市场提供优质产品和卓越的客户支持方面建立了卓越的声誉。他们的专业知识和全国分销能力使他们成为理想的合作伙伴，将 ELF 的热情、欧洲技术、OEM 批准的配方和赛车运动启发的性能带给全国更多的驾驶员和维修专业人员。”

paras.en: “We are thrilled to bring ELF oil into the SSF family. Both of our companies carry rich histories rooted in the automotive aftermarket, making this collaboration a natural fit,” said Ryan Lessig, vice president of product and marketing at SSF Imported Auto Parts. “ELF’s tagline, ‘A Brand of Passion,’ aligns perfectly with SSF’s founding mission – driven by a shared passion for serving European repair specialists. Combined with ELF’s strong brand name and proven performance, this partnership reinforces our commitment to delivering uncompromising quality to the technicians who rely on us.”
paras.zh: SSF 进口汽车零部件产品和营销副总裁 Ryan Lessig 表​​示：“我们很高兴将 ELF 油引入 SSF 家族。我们两家公司都拥有植根于汽车售后市场的丰富历史，因此此次合作水到渠成。” “ELF 的口号‘激情品牌’与 SSF 的创始使命完美契合，即服务欧洲维修专家的共同热情。结合 ELF 强大的品牌知名度和久经考验的性能，这种合作伙伴关系强化了我们为依赖我们的技术人员提供毫不妥协的质量的承诺。”

articles.title: Schwartz Advisors’ Keith Zar to Receive Northwood Award
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Schwartz Advisors announced that Managing Partner Keith Zar will receive Northwood University’s Automotive Aftermarket Management Education Award. The M&A advisory and strategic planning firm serves the mobility aftermarket. Northwood will honor Zar on Nov. 3 during an awards ceremony at AAPEX in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Schwartz Advisors 宣布执行合伙人 Keith Zar 将获得诺斯伍德大学汽车售后市场管理教育奖。这家并购咨询和战略规划公司为移动售后市场提供服务。诺斯伍德将于 11 月 3 日在拉斯维加斯 AAPEX 举行的颁奖典礼上向扎尔致敬。

paras.en: Schwartz Advisors Executive Recognized for Industry Contributions
paras.zh: 施瓦茨顾问高管因行业贡献而获得认可

paras.en: Northwood University presents the Automotive Aftermarket Management Education Award annually. The award recognizes industry leaders who demonstrate substantial dedication to education and advancing the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德大学每年颁发汽车售后市场管理教育奖。该奖项旨在表彰那些对教育和推动汽车售后市场做出巨大奉献的行业领导者。

paras.en: Since Northwood established the award program in 1975, recipients have included many of the industry’s most influential executives and leaders.
paras.zh: 自 1975 年 Northwood 设立该奖项计划以来，获奖者包括许多业内最具影响力的高管和领导者。

paras.en: “Keith has spent his career helping business owners, executives and investors understand not only how to structure successful transactions, but how to make better strategic decisions,” said Rick Schwartz, co-founder and CEO of Schwartz Advisors. “His ability to share his knowledge and experience with others embodies the spirit of this award. We’re incredibly proud to see him recognized by Northwood.”
paras.zh: Schwartz Advisors 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Rick Schwartz 表示：“Keith 的职业生涯致力于帮助企业主、高管和投资者了解如何构建成功的交易，以及如何做出更好的战略决策。” “他与他人分享知识和经验的能力体现了该奖项的精神。看到他得到诺斯伍德的认可，我们感到非常自豪。”

paras.en: Zar’s Experience in the Automotive Aftermarket
paras.zh: Zar在汽车售后市场的经验

paras.en: A lawyer by training and an aftermarket professional by experience, Zar oversees Schwartz Advisors’ sell-side M&A practice.
paras.zh: Zar 是一名经过培训的律师和经验丰富的售后专业人士，负责监督 Schwartz Advisors 的卖方并购业务。

paras.en: During his career, he has participated in hundreds of transactions as a legal, financial and strategic adviser. At Schwartz Advisors, he has helped owners of automotive and heavy-duty aftermarket businesses navigate important and complex decisions throughout their companies’ lifecycles.
paras.zh: 在他的职业生涯中，他作为法律、财务和战略顾问参与了数百笔交易。在 Schwartz Advisors，他帮助汽车和重型售后市场企业的所有者在公司的整个生命周期中做出重要而复杂的决策。

paras.en: Several current Schwartz Advisors colleagues have also received Northwood University’s Automotive Aftermarket Management Education Award:
paras.zh: 施瓦茨顾问公司的几位现任同事还获得了诺斯伍德大学的汽车售后市场管理教育奖：

paras.en: “The number of people on the Schwartz Advisors team who have received this award says a great deal about the depth of experience we bring to our clients,” Zar said. “I’m honored to join colleagues whom I respect tremendously, and I’m especially grateful to Northwood University for its longstanding commitment to developing the next generation of aftermarket leaders.”
paras.zh: “施瓦茨顾问团队中获得此奖项的人数充分说明了我们为客户带来的经验的深度，”扎尔说。 “我很荣幸能加入我非常尊敬的同事们，我特别感谢诺斯伍德大学长期以来致力于培养下一代售后市场领导者。”

articles.title: ZF Aftermarket Unveils Unified Packaging, Expanded Solutions
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: ZF Aftermarket said it will make a strong statement at AAPEX 2026 with the North American debut of its new unified brand packaging design, alongside an expanded portfolio of solutions for independent workshops. First presented at Automechanika Frankfurt 2026, ZF Aftermarket’s unified global brand and packaging approach makes it easier for workshops, distributors and fleets to recognize products, navigate the portfolio and access the right support, the company said.
paras.zh: 采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 表示，将在 AAPEX 2026 上发表强有力的声明，在北美首次亮相其新的统一品牌包装设计，以及针对独立车间的扩展解决方案组合。该公司表示，采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 的统一全球品牌和包装方法在 2026 年法兰克福汽配展上首次亮相，使车间、经销商和车队能够更轻松地识别产品、浏览产品组合并获得正确的支持。

paras.en: Rolling out in phases, the new approach strengthens the visible connection between ZF and the established Lemförder, SACHS, WABCO and TRW brands while preserving the expertise and trust each has built with customers, the company said. This strategy brings parts, diagnostics, training and digital solutions together behind one objective: Maximizing Uptime.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，分阶段推出的新方法加强了采埃孚与 Lemförder、SACHS、WABCO 和 TRW 品牌之间的明显联系，同时保留了各自与客户建立的专业知识和信任。这一战略将零件、诊断、培训和数字解决方案结合在一起，实现一个目标：最大限度地延长正常运行时间。

paras.en: AAPEX 2026 Exhibit and On-Site Engagement
paras.zh: AAPEX 2026 展览及现场参与

paras.en: ZF leaders will be on site at AAPEX 2026 at Booth #F13011 to welcome attendees to the company’s all-new display in The Forum. Bringing ZF Aftermarket’s end-to-end solutions ecosystem to life, the exhibit will showcase key products and solutions for passenger cars and commercial vehicles, ZF [pro]Diagnostics, ZF [pro]Tech training, remanufacturing and the latest Chassis 2.0 technologies.
paras.zh: 采埃孚领导人将在 AAPEX 2026 现场，在 #F13011 展位欢迎与会者参观该公司在论坛上的全新展示。展会将采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 的端到端解决方案生态系统带入生活，展示乘用车和商用车的关键产品和解决方案、采埃孚 [pro]诊断、采埃孚 [pro]技术培训、再制造和最新的底盘 2.0 技术。

paras.en: Unified Brand Identity to Support Aftermarket Needs
paras.zh: 统一的品牌标识支持售后市场需求

paras.en: As part of ZF Group, ZF Aftermarket builds on the technology company’s original-equipment expertise to serve the evolving needs of the aftermarket. By combining this expertise with a clearer, more consistent ZF brand identity across its portfolio, ZF Aftermarket gives customers easier access to the products, services and solutions they need to Maximize Uptime, while product quality, availability and established brand expertise remain unchanged, the company explained.
paras.zh: 作为采埃孚集团的一部分，采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 以技术公司的原始设备专业知识为基础，满足售后市场不断变化的需求。该公司解释说，通过将这种专业知识与整个产品组合中更清晰、更一致的采埃孚品牌标识相结合，采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 让客户更容易获得他们所需的产品、服务和解决方案，以最大限度地延长正常运行时间，同时产品质量、可用性和既定的品牌专业知识保持不变。

paras.en: “Our ZF brands stand for the technical expertise, performance quality and OE heritage we are proud to bring to the aftermarket. By creating a more consistent ZF brand identity across our brand portfolio, we are helping our customers make choices they can rely on and that optimize the value workshops, distributors and fleets require. It is another step in delivering holistic solutions that Maximize Uptime,” says Chris Battershell, head of ZF Aftermarket, North America.
paras.zh: “我们的采埃孚品牌代表着技术专业知识、性能品质和原厂传统，我们很自豪能够将其带入售后市场。通过在我们的品牌组合中创建更加一致的采埃孚品牌标识，我们正在帮助客户做出可以信赖的选择，并优化车间、经销商和车队所需的价值。这是提供最大化正常运行时间的整体解决方案的又一步，”采埃孚售后北美地区负责人 Chris Battershell 说道。

paras.en: Consistent, unified packaging will be the most visible expression of the new approach, according to ZF Aftermarket. Introduced gradually across the portfolio, it will create a more cohesive appearance across product categories and show more clearly how ZF, Lemförder, SACHS, WABCO and TRW come together as one aftermarket offering.
paras.zh: 采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 表示，一致、统一的包装将是新方法最明显的体现。它将在整个产品组合中逐步引入，将在各个产品类别中打造更具凝聚力的外观，并更清楚地展示采埃孚、Lemförder、SACHS、WABCO 和 TRW 如何整合为一个售后市场产品。

paras.en: In Mexico, BOGE remains an important, well-established brand whose market presence and customer recognition will continue to play a key role in ZF Aftermarket’s regional portfolio. Customers will retain the product brands they know, now with a stronger visual connection to ZF’s technology, systems knowledge and global support.
paras.zh: 在墨西哥，伯格仍然是一个重要的、成熟的品牌，其市场影响力和客户认可度将继续在采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 的区域产品组合中发挥关键作用。客户将保留他们所知道的产品品牌，现在与采埃孚的技术、系统知识和全球支持有更紧密的视觉联系。

paras.en: “This evolution builds on the strength and legacy of our established brands while creating a clearer, more consistent connection to ZF. The unified design will help customers recognize our portfolio more easily and understand the full breadth of expertise, services and solutions available to support their business,” says Camilla Davison, global head of marketing and communications, ZF Aftermarket.
paras.zh: “这一演变建立在我们知名品牌的实力和传统之上，同时与采埃孚建立了更清晰、更一致的联系。统一的设计将帮助客户更轻松地认识我们的产品组合，并了解可用于支持其业务的全面专业知识、服务和解决方案，”采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 营销和传播全球主管 Camilla Davison 表示。

articles.title: AWDA Names Richard and Lisa Beirne 2026 Outstanding Leader
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, celebrated the recipients of its 2026 AWDA Industry Awards during the AWDA General Session on Nov. 1 in Las Vegas, Nevada. The annual awards take place during the AWDA Annual Business Conference and recognize individuals who exemplify leadership, innovation, education and service to the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 于 11 月 1 日在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 AWDA 全体会议上庆祝了 2026 年 AWDA 行业奖的获得者。该年度奖项在 AWDA 年度商务会议期间颁发，旨在表彰在汽车售后市场发挥领导力、创新、教育和服务作用的个人。

paras.en: AWDA presented its 2026 Outstanding Leadership Award in honor of Jack Creamer to Richard and Lisa Beirne of Auto Parts Headquarters.
paras.zh: AWDA 向汽车零部件总部的 Richard Beirne 和 Lisa Beirne 颁发了 2026 年杰出领导奖，以表彰 Jack Creamer。

paras.en: Formerly known as the “Leader of the Year,” the award honors an aftermarket professional who has contributed to the industry in a unique and significant way. It is named for former AWDA President Jack Creamer. The award was presented by 2025 recipient Don Bickle, former AWDA Treasurer.
paras.zh: 该奖项以前被称为“年度领袖”，旨在表彰以独特而重大的方式为该行业做出贡献的售后市场专业人士。它以 AWDA 前主席 Jack Creamer 的名字命名。该奖项由 2025 年获奖者、前 AWDA 财务主管 Don Bickle 颁发。

paras.en: Richard’s aftermarket career spans nearly six decades, beginning in 1968 as a delivery driver. With Lisa’s steadfast partnership, he led United Auto Supply as president and CEO, guided its successful partnership with Automotive Parts Headquarters (APH), and built a reputation for valuing employees, customers and supplier partners. Today, he serves as a senior advisor for APH, while he and Lisa continue supporting APH and Auto Value expansion efforts throughout the Midwest.
paras.zh: Richard 的售后职业生涯长达近 60 年，从 1968 年担任送货司机开始。在 Lisa 坚定的合作伙伴关系下，他作为总裁兼首席执行官领导了 United Auto Supply，指导其与汽车零部件总部 (APH) 的成功合作，并建立了重视员工、客户和供应商合作伙伴的声誉。如今，他担任 APH 的高级顾问，同时他和 Lisa 继续支持 APH 和汽车价值在中西部地区的扩张工作。

paras.en: Richard’s decades of AWDA service include roles as board member, treasurer, chairman, treasurer emeritus and lifetime board member. He also helped lead AWDA’s merger with the Automotive Aftermarket Industry Association. Richard and Lisa have participated in Auto Care Association Leadership Meetings, Capitol Hill advocacy and Right to Repair initiatives, while consistently supporting the Auto Care Political Action Committee.
paras.zh: Richard 在 AWDA 服务了数十年，担任过董事会成员、财务主管、董事长、名誉财务主管和终身董事会成员。他还帮助领导了 AWDA 与汽车售后市场行业协会的合并。理查德和丽莎参加了汽车护理协会领导会议、国会山倡导和维修权倡议，同时一贯支持汽车护理政治行动委员会。

paras.en: The Beirnes’ investment in the next generation is equally significant. Richard serves on the University of the Aftermarket Foundation Board of Trustees and has supported its scholarship and contributions work. Richard and Lisa became Lifetime Trustees in 2019 and, in 2025, were the first individuals named Gold Lifetime Trustees, recognizing cumulative contributions exceeding $250,000.
paras.zh: 贝尔恩斯家族对下一代的投资同样重要。理查德在售后市场大学基金会董事会任职，并支持其奖学金和捐款工作。 Richard 和 Lisa 于 2019 年成为终身受托人，并于 2025 年成为第一批被命名为“黄金终身受托人”的个人，表彰累计捐款超过 25 万美元。

articles.title: Eric Johnson Receives 2026 AWDA Pursuit of Excellence Award
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented its 2026 Pursuit of Excellence Award to Eric Johnson, President and CEO of Arnold Motor Supply and The Merrill Company in Spencer, Iowa. The award was presented by AWDA Secretary Cliff Hovis at the association’s 2026 Annual Conference on November in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 向位于爱荷华州斯宾塞的 Arnold Motor Supply 和 Merrill Company 总裁兼首席执行官 Eric Johnson 颁发了 2026 年追求卓越奖。该奖项由 AWDA 秘书 Cliff Hovis 在 11 月于拉斯维加斯举行的协会 2026 年年会上颁发。

paras.en: Established in 1983, the award recognizes an AWDA member for special achievement and for setting high standards in business, volunteer service or advocacy. AWDA Secretary Cliff Hovis presented the award.
paras.zh: 该奖项设立于 1983 年，旨在表彰 AWDA 成员在商业、志愿服务或宣传方面取得的特殊成就和制定的高标准。 AWDA 秘书长克利夫·霍维斯颁发了该奖项。

paras.en: As president and managing partner of Arnold Motor Supply, Eric Johnson has combined technological advancement with a customer- and employee-first culture. He championed investments in e-commerce, digital tools, data-driven operations and cybersecurity education to strengthen customer engagement, operational efficiency and employee readiness.
paras.zh: 作为 Arnold Motor Supply 的总裁兼管理合伙人，Eric Johnson 将技术进步与客户和员工至上的文化结合起来。他倡导对电子商务、数字工具、数据驱动的运营和网络安全教育进行投资，以加强客户参与度、运营效率和员工准备程度。

paras.en: Johnson has also built a culture of continuous learning through training for employees, managers and sales teams. The company’s annual Roadshow brings together more than 130 vendors and over 1,500 attendees for hands-on training, product education and collaboration.
paras.zh: 约翰逊还通过对员工、经理和销售团队的培训建立了持续学习的文化。该公司的年度路演汇聚了 130 多家供应商和 1,500 多名与会者，进行实践培训、产品教育和协作。

paras.en: Beyond Arnold Motor Supply, Eric serves on the Board of Directors of the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc., and supports Alliance University, Northwood University’s University of the Aftermarket and other professional development programs. His contributions were recognized with the 2025 Mort Schwartz Excellence in Education Award. He has also supported charitable initiatives, including the company’s annual golf outing benefiting Tori’s Angels, and provided steady, employee-focused leadership during historic flooding affecting the company and its communities.
paras.zh: 除了 Arnold Motor Supply 之外，Eric 还担任售后汽车零部件联盟 (Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc.) 的董事会成员，并支持联盟大学 (Alliance University)、诺斯伍德大学 (Northwood University) 的售后市场大学和其他专业发展项目。他的贡献获得了 2025 年 Mort Schwartz 卓越教育奖的认可。他还支持慈善活动，包括公司每年一度为托里天使 (Tori’s Angels) 举办的高尔夫郊游活动，并在影响公司及其社区的历史性洪水期间提供稳定、以员工为中心的领导。

articles.title: Bennie Skelton Named 2026 WIX Filters Counter Pro of the Year
articles.author: Jason Morgan

paras.en: WIX Filters and Counterman have named Bennie Skelton of Crow-Burlingame’s Bumper to Bumper store in Neosho, Missouri, the 2026 Counter Professional of the Year. Skelton brings more than four decades of parts experience to the counter, building customer relationships that now extend across generations. His career reflects a commitment to helping customers and a determination to overcome challenges.
paras.zh: WIX Filters 和 Counterman 任命密苏里州 Neosho 的 Crow-Burlingame Bumper to Bumper 商店的 Bennie Skelton 为 2026 年度柜台专业人士。 Skelton 将四十多年的零件经验带到了柜台，建立了跨越几代人的客户关系。他的职业生涯体现了帮助客户的承诺和克服挑战的决心。

paras.en: Skelton entered the parts field in 1980 when he enlisted in the U.S. Air Force. During 12 years of service, he learned to identify parts using microfiche and paper catalogs, measure engine components and supervise military and civilian personnel. While stationed in California, he worked weekends at an auto parts story after leaving the Air Force in 1992. Skelton joined Crow-Burlingame in 2009.
paras.zh: Skelton 于 1980 年加入美国空军，进入零部件领域。在 12 年的服役生涯中，他学会了使用缩微胶片和纸质目录来识别零件、测量发动机部件以及监督军事和文职人员。 1992 年离开空军后，他在加利福尼亚州驻扎期间，周末在一家汽车零部件公司工作。Skelton 于 2009 年加入 Crow-Burlingame。

paras.en: “Bennie has great customer service and has a lifetime of knowledge,” said Darren Brewer, manager of the Neosho store. “I don’t have to tell him to do something when he sees it needs to be done, he does it. He’s the best man I’ve ever worked with. ”
paras.zh: Neosho 商店经理达伦·布鲁尔 (Darren Brewer) 表示：“Bennie 拥有出色的客户服务和终生的知识。” “当他认为需要做某事时，我不必告诉他做某事，他就会去做。他是我共事过的最好的人。”

paras.en: Brewer credits Skelton with helping strengthen the store’s financial performance and praised his initiative, sales ability and perseverance.
paras.zh: 布鲁尔称赞斯克尔顿帮助加强了商店的财务业绩，并赞扬了他的主动性、销售能力和毅力。

paras.en: In 2012, Skelton suffered a major stroke that affected his speech and the use of his right side. He spent months relearning how to walk and talk, adapting to perform tasks left-handed. Today, he continues building hydraulic hoses, pulling parts and completing paperwork while serving the customers he knows so well.
paras.zh: 2012年，斯克尔顿遭遇严重中风，影响了他的言语和右侧肢体的使用。他花了几个月的时间重新学习如何走路和说话，以适应用左手执行任务。如今，他继续制造液压软管、拉动零件并完成文书工作，同时为他熟悉的客户提供服务。

paras.en: Established in 1986, Counter Professional of the Year recognizes excellence among automotive aftermarket parts professionals. WIX Filters has sponsored the program since 2006.
paras.zh: Counter Professional of the Year 成立于 1986 年，旨在表彰汽车售后市场零部件专业人士的卓越表现。 WIX Filters 自 2006 年以来一直赞助该计划。

articles.title: Mars-bound astronauts could face years of heart scarring, rat study hints
articles.author: Helena Kudiabor

paras.en: Exposure to space radiation may increase astronauts' risk of a dangerous heart condition, a new study in rats hints.
paras.zh: 一项针对老鼠的新研究暗示，暴露于太空辐射可能会增加宇航员患危险心脏病的风险。

paras.en: The research, published Sept. 30 in the journal PLOS One, found that rats exposed to levels of radiation similar to what an astronaut might experience on a long-term trip to Mars developed more scar tissue around the small blood vessels of their hearts than rats that were not exposed to this radiation. This scar tissue is indicative of a condition known as cardiac fibrosis, which is known to increase the risk of heart failure.
paras.zh: 这项研究于 9 月 30 日发表在《PLOS One》杂志上，研究发现，暴露于类似于宇航员在长期火星旅行中可能经历的辐射水平的老鼠，与未暴露于这种辐射的老鼠相比，其心脏小血管周围会形成更多的疤痕组织。这种疤痕组织表明存在一种称为心脏纤维化的疾病，众所周知，这种疾病会增加心力衰竭的风险。

paras.en: This scar tissue was observed nearly a year after the rats were first exposed to the radiation.
paras.zh: 这种疤痕组织是在老鼠第一次暴露于辐射近一年后观察到的。

paras.en: But since this study was in rats, it cannot definitively say whether this effect will play out in humans. For example, given that humans have a longer life expectancy than rats (80 years versus 2 to 4 years), the effects seen in rats may take around 30 years to show up in humans. However, the study authors say the research highlights the importance of following astronauts' health long after they return to Earth.
paras.zh: 但由于这项研究是在老鼠身上进行的，因此不能明确地说这种效应是否会在人类身上发挥作用。例如，考虑到人类的预期寿命比老鼠长（80 年对 2 到 4 年），在老鼠身上看到的效果可能需要大约 30 年才能在人类身上显现出来。然而，研究作者表示，这项研究强调了在宇航员返回地球后很长时间内跟踪他们的健康状况的重要性。

paras.en: "The message that we try to convey … is that the follow-up time is really important," study co-author John Baker, a professor of surgery in the Radiation Bioscience Laboratory at the Medical College of Wisconsin, told Live Science. "When astronauts come back to the Earth, they expect — and we expect — that they're going to live for a long time. I think we have to be wary that they could well develop at least some type of cardiac disease."
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、威斯康星医学院放射生物科学实验室的外科教授约翰·贝克 (John Baker) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“我们试图传达的信息是，随访时间非常重要。” “当宇航员返回地球时，他们期望——我们也期望——他们会活很长一段时间。我认为我们必须警惕他们可能会患上至少某种类型的心脏病。”

paras.en: The link between exposure to radiation and cardiac issues has been well documented. However, "no astronaut has ever been exposed to galactic cosmic radiation for long periods of time," Baker said, which makes it difficult to determine exactly how space radiation affects the heart.
paras.zh: 辐射暴露与心脏问题之间的联系已得到充分证明。然而，“没有宇航员长期暴露在银河宇宙辐射下，”贝克说，这使得很难确定太空辐射如何影响心脏。

paras.en: Although Baker and his team previously pinpointed cardiac issues among rats exposed to radiation, this new study utilized NASA's Simulated Galactic Cosmic Ray Simulation (SimGCRSim). This new simulator provides a more precise comparison of the levels of space radiation an astronaut might experience while exploring deep space for more than a year.
paras.zh: 尽管贝克和他的团队之前指出了暴露于辐射的老鼠的心脏问题，但这项新研究利用了美国宇航局的模拟银河宇宙射线模拟（SimGCRSim）。这款新模拟器可以更精确地比较宇航员在探索深空一年多时可能经历的空间辐射水平。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: During the study, the researchers exposed rats to several minutes of radiation proportionate to their size, similar to what they might experience on a trip to Mars and back (a roughly 18-month round trip, with current technology). Some of the rats' hind legs were suspended, to "simulate conditions of weightlessness," Baker said.
paras.zh: 在研究过程中，研究人员将老鼠暴露在与它们的体型成比例的辐射中几分钟，类似于它们在火星往返之旅中可能经历的情况（使用当前技术，大约需要 18 个月的往返时间）。贝克说，一些老鼠的后腿被悬挂起来，以“模拟失重条件”。

paras.en: After 360 days, the rats that were exposed to cosmic radiation developed twice as much scar tissue around the heart's small blood vessels than unexposed rats. This buildup of scar tissue means "the heart can't relax to the point when it needs to," thereby increasing the risk of heart failure, Baker said.
paras.zh: 360天后，暴露于宇宙辐射的老鼠心脏小血管周围形成的疤痕组织是未暴露于宇宙辐射的老鼠的两倍。贝克说，疤痕组织的堆积意味着“心脏无法放松到需要的程度”，从而增加心力衰竭的风险。

paras.en: This effect was not seen in the rats who were exposed only to simulated weightlessness, confirming "it was only the radiation that produced the damaging effect on the heart," Baker said. However, long-term testing revealed that this group of rats had lower levels of key immune cells, suggesting that microgravity also may affect aspects of long-term health. (Numerous studies have shown various short-term health impacts related to microgravity.)
paras.zh: 贝克说，在仅暴露于模拟失重环境的老鼠中没有观察到这种效应，这证实了“只有辐射对心脏产生了损害作用”。然而，长期测试表明，这组老鼠的关键免疫细胞水平较低，这表明微重力也可能影响长期健康的各个方面。 （大量研究表明微重力会对健康产生各种短期影响。）

paras.en: - Spaceflight may harm the reproductive system of astronauts' kids and grandkids, early mouse study suggests
paras.zh: - 早期的小鼠研究表明，太空飞行可能会损害宇航员的孩子和孙子的生殖系统

paras.en: - Scientists finally know why astronauts struggle to poop in space — and reveal a hidden risk of long-haul spaceflight
paras.zh: - 科学家们终于知道为什么宇航员在太空中难以排便——并揭示了长途太空飞行的隐藏风险

paras.en: - Mystery medical episode that left astronaut unable to speak shows one of NASA's biggest risks as moon missions ramp up
paras.zh: - 导致宇航员无法说话的神秘医疗事件表明，随着登月任务的推进，美国宇航局面临的最大风险之一

paras.en: This study "is a very valuable contribution to space biology," Rupak Pathak, an associate professor of pharmaceutical science at the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences who was not involved in the study but holds a doctorate in radiation biology, told Live Science. While rats and humans have clear differences, "they share more than 90% of genetic information," he said, as well as very similar cardiac systems.
paras.zh: 阿肯色大学医学科学分校药物科学副教授鲁帕克·帕塔克（Rupak Pathak）表示，这项研究“对空间生物学做出了非常有价值的贡献”，他没有参与这项研究，但拥有辐射生物学博士学位。他说，虽然老鼠和人类有明显的差异，但“它们共享 90% 以上的遗传信息”，而且心脏系统也非常相似。

paras.en: Given that the study authors were able to expose the rats to radiation only once, Pathak would like to see further experiments exploring whether chronic radiation exposure affects the function of the heart and other vital organs.
paras.zh: 鉴于研究作者只能将老鼠暴露在辐射下一次，帕塔克希望看到进一步的实验来探索慢性辐射暴露是否会影响心脏和其他重要器官的功能。

paras.en: Baker and his colleagues hope that future experiments can be used to help NASA implement safeguards for astronauts on long-term missions, such as providing astronauts heart medications or improving shielding for the spacecraft.
paras.zh: 贝克和他的同事希望未来的实验能够帮助美国宇航局为执行长期任务的宇航员提供保障，例如为宇航员提供心脏药物或改善航天器的屏蔽。

paras.en: "The more we know before we start, then the better NASA is going to be at working out what types of countermeasures can be developed," said Baker.
paras.zh: 贝克说：“我们在开始之前了解得越多，美国宇航局就能更好地制定出可以制定哪些类型的对策。”

paras.en: Lenarczyk, M., Kronenberg, A., Kwok, A., Borg, A., Alsheikh, A. J., Mathison, A. J., Zimmermann, M. T., Lawton, S. B. R., Raff, H., Willey, J., Komorowski, R. A., Urrutia, R., & Baker, J. E. (2026). Multiple simulated spaceflight stressors impact cardiac fibrosis, calcium dynamics, immune function, cytokines and gene variants in rat, Rattus norvegicus. paras.en: Helena Kudiabor is a New Jersey-based health and science journalist. Originally from London, she holds a Bachelor of Arts in global health and social medicine from King's College London and a Master of Science in science communication from Imperial College London. Her work has appeared in outlets such as Nature, SELF, and The Transmitter.
paras.zh: 海伦娜·库迪亚博尔 (Helena Kudiabor) 是新泽西州的一名健康和科学记者。她来自伦敦，拥有伦敦国王学院全球健康和社会医学文学学士学位和伦敦帝国理工学院科学传播理学硕士学位。她的作品曾出现在《自然》、《SELF》和《The Transmitter》等媒体上。

articles.title: 'Quite a light show': NASA astronaut snaps atmospheric fireball as Russian rocket explodes over West Africa
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: What's in the photos? Space debris from a Russian rocket burning up upon reentry
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？俄罗斯火箭重返大气层时燃烧的太空碎片

paras.en: Who took the photos? NASA astronaut Chris Williams
paras.zh: 照片是谁拍的？美国宇航局宇航员克里斯·威廉姆斯

paras.en: Earlier this year, an astronaut on board the International Space Station (ISS) snapped some striking photos, and an eerily beautiful video, of a "fireball" streaking over Earth as chunks of space debris burned up in the nighttime sky.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，国际空间站（ISS）上的一名宇航员拍摄了一些引人注目的照片和一段异常美丽的视频，其中一个“火球”在地球上空划过，大块的太空碎片在夜空中燃烧。

paras.en: NASA's Chris Williams, who lived and worked on the ISS between November 2025 and July 2026, captured the eye-catching images from the station's cupola — a large, roughly dome-shaped series of windows that constantly points down at our planet — and later shared them on the social media platform X.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的克里斯·威廉姆斯 (Chris Williams) 于 2025 年 11 月至 2026 年 7 月期间在国际空间站生活和工作，他从国际空间站的冲天炉（一系列大致圆顶形的大窗户，不断指向我们的星球）捕捉到了引人注目的图像，随后在社交媒体平台 X 上分享了这些图像。

paras.en: "Just as we were passing over West Africa, I saw a bright object directly below us, streaking through the upper atmosphere," Williams wrote in the post. "I saw its tail grow and then split apart into a shower of smaller pieces," he added. "It was quite a light show!"
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯在帖子中写道：“正当我们飞越西非时，我看到我们正下方有一个明亮的物体，穿过高层大气。” “我看到它的尾巴长大了，然后分裂成一大堆小碎片，”他补充道。 “这真是一场灯光秀！”

paras.en: Williams initially peered down at Earth to catch a glimpse of the Russian cargo spacecraft Progress 95, which successfully delivered essential supplies and additional equipment to the ISS later the same day. Instead, he saw what he believed was "some piece of orbital debris or a satellite breaking up as it entered the atmosphere."
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯最初凝视地球，瞥见了俄罗斯货运飞船进步 95 号，该飞船于当天晚些时候成功向国际空间站运送了必需品和附加设备。相反，他看到了他认为是“一些轨道碎片或卫星在进入大气层时破裂的东西”。

paras.en: Live Science's sister site Space.com later revealed that Williams had actually witnessed the burning remains of the Russian Soyuz rocket that had carried Progress 95 into space, after it lifted off from a recently repaired launchpad at the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan.
paras.zh: Live Science 的姊妹网站 Space.com 后来透露，威廉姆斯实际上亲眼目睹了俄罗斯联盟号火箭的燃烧残骸，该火箭将进步 95 号运载火箭从哈萨克斯坦拜科努尔航天发射场最近修复的发射台升空。

paras.en: Shortly after deploying the resupply shuttle into low Earth orbit, the rocket's fairings and booster fell back toward our planet as expected, breaking apart into smaller pieces that were superheated and later vaporized by intense friction as they hit the upper atmosphere, according to Space.com. A very similar fireball was seen above Australia in August 2023, when another Soyuz rocket reentered the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 据Space.com报道，在将补给航天飞机部署到近地轨道后不久，火箭的整流罩和助推器如预期般落回地球，分裂成更小的碎片，这些碎片在撞击高层大气时过热，随后因强烈的摩擦而蒸发。 2023 年 8 月，当另一枚联盟号火箭重新进入大气层时，在澳大利亚上空看到了一个非常相似的火球。

paras.en: Russia's prior resupply mission, Progress 94, also made headlines earlier this year when one of its antennae failed to deploy after separation from its Soyuz rocket, forcing cosmonauts (Russian astronauts) to use a remote control "backup system" to dock the spacecraft to the ISS.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯此前的补给任务“进步 94”号也在今年早些时候成为头条新闻，当时其一根天线在与联盟号火箭分离后未能展开，迫使宇航员（俄罗斯宇航员）使用遥控“备份系统”将航天器与国际空间站对接。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Historically, the only fireballs visible in Earth's skies have been those caused by meteors, which can similarly break apart in flames. We were recently reminded of this when fireballs were spotted above the U.S. this spring, including one space rock that exploded with a massive sonic boom over Ohio and another that crashed through the roof of a house in Houston. (A NASA statement said the fireball Williams witnessed also may have been caused by meteor activity but was more likely to be the Soyuz rocket.)
paras.zh: 从历史上看，地球天空中唯一可见的火球是由流星引起的，它们同样会在火焰中分解。最近，今年春天在美国上空发现火球时，我们想起了这一点，其中包括一颗太空岩石在俄亥俄州上空爆炸并产生巨大的音爆，另一颗则撞穿了休斯敦一栋房屋的屋顶。 （美国宇航局的一份声明称，威廉姆斯目睹的火球也可能是由流星活动引起的，但更有可能是联盟号火箭。）

paras.en: However, fireballs from human-made objects are becoming more common. The number of spacecraft orbiting Earth has skyrocketed (pun intended) in recent decades, and "what goes up must come down."
paras.zh: 然而，人造物体产生的火球正变得越来越常见。近几十年来，绕地球运行的航天器数量猛增（双关语），“有升必降”。

paras.en: Most spacecraft and large pieces of space junk burn up around 50 miles (80 kilometers) above Earth's surface — just below the imaginary boundary with space, known as the Kármán line. While this may lead to visually stunning spectacles like the one Williams captured, scientists are starting to realize that these fireballs may be having a bigger impact on the upper atmosphere than they previously expected.
paras.zh: 大多数航天器和大块太空垃圾都会在地球表面上方约 50 英里（80 公里）处燃烧，即位于假想的太空边界（即卡门线）下方。虽然这可能会导致像威廉姆斯捕捉到的那样令人震惊的视觉奇观，但科学家们开始意识到这些火球对高层大气的影响可能比他们之前预期的更大。

paras.en: In recent years, researchers have detected a sharp increase in atmospheric metal pollution from vaporized spacecraft. And while they are still trying to figure out what effect this may have, some scientists have proposed that it could affect the ozone layer or potentially alter Earth's magnetic field.
paras.zh: 近年来，研究人员发现汽化航天器造成的大气金属污染急剧增加。虽然他们仍在试图弄清楚这可能会产生什么影响，但一些科学家提出，它可能会影响臭氧层或可能改变地球磁场。

paras.en: Additionally, as the number of falling spacecraft rises, the chances that debris may fall to Earth's surface — after failing to properly burn up upon reentry — also increase. This came to the fore in March 2024, when the remains of a 3-ton battery pack that was discarded from the ISS crashed into a family home in Florida.
paras.zh: 此外，随着坠落航天器数量的增加，碎片在重返地球时未能正确燃烧后落到地球表面的可能性也会增加。 2024 年 3 月，这一问题凸显出来，当时从国际空间站丢弃的一个 3 吨重的电池组残骸坠入佛罗里达州的一户人家。

paras.en: Space Shuttle's final 'photobomb' turns 15
paras.zh: 航天飞机最后的“照片炸弹”15 岁了

paras.en: This 2011 astronaut photo captured one of NASA's iconic space shuttles passing between Earth and the International Space Station for the very last time.
paras.zh: 这张 2011 年宇航员的照片捕捉到了美国宇航局标志性航天飞机最后一次在地球和国际空间站之间经过的情景。

paras.en: During the Sept. 11 attacks, NASA astronaut Frank Culbertson — the only American not on Earth at the time — snapped a "sobering" shot of smoke pouring across New York City as the second tower fell.
paras.zh: 在 9 月 11 日的袭击中，美国宇航局宇航员弗兰克·卡尔伯森（当时唯一不在地球上的美国人）拍下了第二座塔倒塌时纽约市上空倾泻而下的烟雾的“发人深省”的照片。

paras.en: A 2016 satellite photo shows Hurricane Madeline and Hurricane Lester heading straight toward Hawaii. When viewed from above, the twin cyclones and the surrounding clouds look eerily like a giant smiley face.
paras.zh: 2016 年的卫星照片显示，飓风马德琳和飓风莱斯特直奔夏威夷。从上方看去，双气旋和周围的云看起来像一张巨大的笑脸，诡异得令人毛骨悚然。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: A 3,200-pound NASA spacecraft could fall to Earth tonight
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: NASA's decades-old Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory is rapidly falling out of orbit and could tumble back to Earth as early as tonight (Nov. 3), the space agency says.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局表示，拥有数十年历史的尼尔·盖尔斯·斯威夫特天文台正在迅速脱离轨道，最早可能在今晚（11 月 3 日）返回地球。

paras.en: According to NASA's latest estimates, shared yesterday (Nov. 2), the roughly 3,200-pound (1,450 kilograms) spacecraft will likely reenter Earth's atmosphere around 3:30 a.m. EST Wednesday (Nov. 4), with an uncertainty of plus or minus 11 hours — meaning the defunct observatory could plunge down as early as this evening.
paras.zh: 根据美国宇航局昨天（11 月 2 日）发布的最新估计，这艘重约 3,200 磅（1,450 公斤）的航天器可能会在美国东部时间周三（11 月 4 日）凌晨 3:30 左右重新进入地球大气层，不确定性为正负 11 小时，这意味着这个已失效的天文台最早可能在今晚坠落。

paras.en: An independent analysis from the private nonprofit Aerospace Corporation, which tracks thousands of objects in orbit, similarly estimates that the telescope will reenter the atmosphere at 5:12 a.m. EST Wednesday, give or take eight hours. Both estimates suggest the Swift spacecraft may be no more by Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: 跟踪数千个轨道上物体的私人非营利性航空航天公司的一项独立分析同样估计，该望远镜将于美国东部时间周三凌晨 5 点 12 分重新进入大气层，大约需要 8 个小时。两项估计都表明，到周三早上，雨燕号航天器可能不再存在。

paras.en: As with all spacecraft reentries, the risk to humans is minimal. Most of the Swift telescope is expected to burn up in the atmosphere, according to NASA. Any surviving fragments will likely fall somewhere between 20.6 degrees south latitude and 20.6 degrees north latitude — a range that includes parts of Mexico, the Caribbean, Central and South America, the Arabian Peninsula, India, Africa and Oceania, but also a lot of ocean.
paras.zh: 与所有航天器再入一样，对人类的风险很小。据美国宇航局称，雨燕望远镜的大部分部件预计将在大气层中燃烧。任何幸存的碎片都可能落在南纬 20.6 度和北纬 20.6 度之间的某个地方——这个范围包括墨西哥的部分地区、加勒比海、中美洲和南美洲、阿拉伯半岛、印度、非洲和大洋洲，还有大片海洋。

paras.en: NASA predicts that the chances of Swift debris falling over a populated area are approximately 1 in 2,100. For comparison, the odds of a person being struck by lightning in their lifetime are 1 in 15,300, according to the National Weather Service.
paras.zh: NASA 预测 Swift 碎片落在人口稠密地区的几率约为 2,100 分之一。相比之下，根据国家气象局的数据，一个人一生中被闪电击中的几率为 15,300 分之一。

paras.en: NASA will continue to update their predictions as the reentry window draws closer.
paras.zh: 随着再入窗口的临近，美国宇航局将继续更新他们的预测。

paras.en: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory is a multiwavelength optical, ultraviolet and X-ray telescope that launched in November 2004 on a mission to study the most powerful explosions in space. Initially designed for a two-year primary mission, the telescope ultimately spent more than 10 times that duration hunting for supernovas, gamma-ray bursts and black-hole-induced eruptions around the universe.
paras.zh: Neil Gehrels Swift 天文台是一台多波长光学、紫外线和 X 射线望远镜，于 2004 年 11 月发射，其任务是研究太空中最强大的爆炸。该望远镜最初是为两年的主要任务而设计的，最终花了十倍多的时间来寻找宇宙周围的超新星、伽马射线爆发和黑洞引发的喷发。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: - Gamma-ray bursts reveal largest structure in the universe is bigger and closer to Earth than we knew: 'The jury is still out on what it all means.'
paras.zh: - 伽马射线暴揭示了宇宙中最大的结构比我们所知的更大、更接近地球：“对于这一切意味着什么，尚无定论。”

paras.en: - Did a NASA telescope really 'see' dark matter? Strange gamma-rays spark bold claims, but scientists urge caution
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局望远镜真的“看到”暗物质吗？奇怪的伽马射线引发大胆的主张，但科学家敦促谨慎

paras.en: - Brightest gamma-ray burst ever detected defies explanation
paras.zh: - 迄今为止检测到的最明亮的伽马射线暴无法解释

paras.en: Swift has been rapidly losing altitude for more than a year, after rampant solar activity increased the drag on the aging spacecraft. This past August, a costly mission to boost Swift's orbit with a private spacecraft failed shortly after launch, hammering the final nail in Swift's coffin.
paras.zh: 一年多来，太阳活动频繁，增加了老化航天器的阻力，雨燕号的高度一直在迅速下降。今年八月，一项耗资巨大的私人航天器提升斯威夫特轨道的任务在发射后不久就失败了，给斯威夫特的棺材上敲下了最后一颗钉子。

paras.en: Engineers on the Swift team officially shut down the observatory's science operations on Oct. 20, after the spacecraft fell too low in orbit to continue taking steady observations of the sky.
paras.zh: 10 月 20 日，雨燕号团队的工程师正式关闭了天文台的科学运营，因为该航天器在轨道上坠落得太低，无法继续对天空进行稳定的观测。

paras.en: As Swift goes out with a fiery bang, it leaves behind a trove of scientific data, including contributions to more than 7,000 scientific papers so far, according to NASA. This number will only increase as Swift's final observations are processed.
paras.zh: 据 NASA 称，随着 Swift 的爆炸，它留下了大量的科学数据，其中包括迄今为止对 7000 多篇科学论文的贡献。随着斯威夫特最终观测结果的处理，这个数字只会增加。

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。

articles.title: A 'Poor Man’s Rembrandt' for a Few Hundred Bucks? At Amsterdam's Rembrandt House Museum, a Pop-Up Tattoo Studio Is Inking 17th-Century Masterpieces on Human Canvases

paras.en: Four centuries after famed painter and draughtsman Rembrandt van Rijn defined the Dutch Golden Age with a vivid mastery of light, shadow and emotional depth, his works are once again emerging prolifically in his home country. This time, however, the canvases are human skin.
paras.zh: 著名画家兼制图师伦勃朗·范·莱恩 (Rembrandt van Rijn) 以对光影和情感深度的生动掌握定义了荷兰黄金时代四个世纪后，他的作品再次在祖国大量涌现。然而，这一次，画布是人的皮肤。

paras.en: In a pop-up studio at Amsterdam’s Rembrandt House Museum, where the artist lived and worked for 19 years, a team of renowned tattoo artists have embarked on a two-week effort to recreate the Old Master’s etchings and paintings in ink. For between roughly $110 and $390, the “Poor Man’s Rembrandt Project” is offering visitors the chance to book a tattoo session and leave with a souvenir that lasts a lifetime.
paras.zh: 在这位艺术家生活和工作了 19 年的阿姆斯特丹伦勃朗故居博物馆的一个临时工作室里，一群著名纹身艺术家开始了为期两周的工作，用墨水再现了这位古代大师的蚀刻版画和绘画作品。 “穷人的伦勃朗项目”花费大约 110 至 390 美元，为游客提供预订纹身课程并留下终生难忘的纪念品的机会。

paras.en: “Globally, more tattoos are sold than wall art. An old tattoo artist once called tattoos ‘the poor man’s Rembrandt’—a work of art more affordable than a painting by the old master, yet no less carefully chosen or executed,” Henk Schiffmacher, a world-famous tattoo artist and the project’s lead, says in a statement. “For us, it is an incredible honor to work in the very place where Rembrandt’s spirit still lingers.”
paras.zh: “在全球范围内，纹身销量比墙壁艺术还要多。一位老纹身艺术家曾将纹身称为‘穷人的伦勃朗’——这是一件比古代大师的画作更便宜的艺术品，但其选择或制作的仔细程度却丝毫不减，”世界著名纹身艺术家兼该项目的负责人 Henk Schiffmacher 在一份声明中说道。 “对我们来说，能够在伦勃朗精神仍然萦绕的地方工作是一种难以置信的荣幸。”

paras.en: Schiffmacher, known in the business as Hanky Panky, is joined by artists Tycho Veldhoen, Morrison Cheyenne Schiffmacher, Rupa van Teylingen, Frederik Moens and Olof Arrevik. This is Schiffmacher's second iteration of “The Poor Man’s Rembrandt Project.” Its first edition, launched in 2023, was considered a resounding success, not least because of Schiffmacher’s stellar reputation as a tattoo artist and art historian. Throughout his decades-long career, before tattooing was mainstream, he organized some of Europe’s first tattoo conventions.
paras.zh: Schiffmacher，在业内被称为 Hanky Panky，与艺术家 Tycho Veldhoen、Morrison Cheyenne Schiffmacher、Rupa van Teylingen、Frederik Moens 和 Olof Arrevik 一起参与其中。这是希夫马赫的“穷人的伦勃朗项目”的第二次迭代。它的第一版于 2023 年推出，被认为取得了巨大成功，尤其是因为 Schiffmacher 作为纹身艺术家和艺术史学家的声誉。在他长达数十年的职业生涯中，在纹身成为主流之前，他组织了一些欧洲首个纹身大会。

paras.en: Schiffmacher was one of the few people “who cared about tattooing enough to make sure its visual, cultural heritage was kept and looked after and not chucked in the bin,” Matt Lodder, an art historian at the University of Essex, tells Mike Corder of the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 埃塞克斯大学艺术史学家马特·洛德 (Matt Lodder) 告诉美联社的迈克·科德 (Mike Corder)，希夫马赫是少数几个“足够关心纹身，以确保其视觉和文化遗产得到保留和照顾，而不是被扔进垃圾箱”的人之一。

paras.en: Since the project launched on October 26, most of the tattoos have come from the artists’ flash sheets. Inspiration for a tattoo can come from anywhere, from the smallest background details of an obscure Rembrandt etching to the most prominent feature of a world-renowned work.
paras.zh: 自10月26日项目启动以来，大部分纹身都来自艺术家的闪片。纹身的灵感可以来自任何地方，从不起眼的伦勃朗蚀刻版画中最小的背景细节到世界知名作品中最突出的特征。

paras.en: These include the elephant named Hanksen that Rembrandt depicted several times, as well as lions, windmills, sailors, merchants and other figures that populate his landscapes and portraits. The artist’s own visage, from his dozens of self-portraits, and signature are also available for the inking.
paras.zh: 其中包括伦勃朗多次描绘的名为汉克森的大象，以及他的风景和肖像画中的狮子、风车、水手、商人和其他人物。艺术家自己的面容（来自他的数十幅自画像）和签名也可用于墨水。

paras.en: “This is all about content,” Milou Halbesma, director of the Rembrandt House Museum, tells the Art Newspaper’s Senay Boztas. “We are a museum of craftsmanship, and we are trying to throw open the craft of Rembrandt and his students as widely as possible. If you translate that to today, we have a number of world-famous Amsterdam creators … And this is a chance to get a tattoo from one of these masters.”
paras.zh: “这一切都与内容有关，”伦勃朗故居博物馆馆长米卢·哈尔贝斯玛 (Milou Halbesma) 告诉《艺术报》的 Senay Boztas。 “我们是一座工艺博物馆，我们正在努力尽可能广泛地展示伦勃朗和他的学生的工艺。如果你把这句话翻译到今天，我们有许多世界著名的阿姆斯特丹创作者……这是一个从其中一位大师那里得到纹身的机会。”

paras.en: One person, 28-year-old Bo Kwakernaak, was selected to participate in the project’s marquee tattoo: a free replication of Rembrandt’s 1633 etching The Descent from the Cross across his entire back. The famous etching—depicting a crowd of people taking Jesus down from the cross following his crucifixion—was chosen for its emotive drama and functional display. “The spine almost becomes part of the cross,” Schiffmacher tells the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 28 岁的博·夸克纳克 (Bo Kwakernaak) 被选中参与该项目的大型纹身：免费复制伦勃朗 1633 年在他整个背部蚀刻的《十字架的降临》。这幅著名的蚀刻画描绘了耶稣受难后一群人将他从十字架上抬下来的情景，因其情感戏剧性和功能性展示而被选中。 “脊柱几乎成为十字架的一部分，”希夫马赫告诉《艺术报》。

paras.en: Created over multiple sessions, the full piece will take the team of tattoo artists, each contributing their expertise to the scene, roughly 20 hours to complete. The tattoo’s final sit-down will take place on the night of November 7 at the museum itself.
paras.zh: 整个作品需要多个纹身艺术家团队进行多次创作，每个人都为场景贡献自己的专业知识，大约需要 20 个小时才能完成。纹身的最后一次静坐将于 11 月 7 日晚上在博物馆举行。

paras.en: Those involved in this year’s effort can’t help but compare Rembrandt, who enjoyed making smaller prints that were more accessible to everyday people, with modern-day tattoo artists.
paras.zh: 参与今年活动的人们不禁将伦勃朗与现代纹身艺术家进行了比较，伦勃朗喜欢制作更适合普通人的较小版画。

paras.en: “I think [Rembrandt] would have some kind of click with Henk Schiffmacher,” Epco Runia, the museum’s head of collections, tells the New York Times’ Nina Siegal. “They have a little bit the same kind of character.”
paras.zh: “我认为伦勃朗会与亨克·希夫马赫产生某种共鸣，”博物馆藏品主管埃普科·鲁尼亚 (Epco Runia) 告诉《纽约时报》的尼娜·西格尔 (Nina Siegal)。 “他们的性格有一点相似。”

paras.en: “The Poor Man’s Rembrandt Project” is available at the Rembrandt House Museum in Amsterdam through November 7, 2026.
paras.zh: “穷人的伦勃朗项目”在阿姆斯特丹伦勃朗博物馆展出至 2026 年 11 月 7 日。

articles.title: Native Hawaiians Descend From a Group of 'Ultravoyagers' Who Sailed About 4,400 Miles From Easter Island, Genetic Study Suggests

paras.en: Almost 1,000 years ago, a group of exceptionally skilled seafarers left Easter Island, also called Rapa Nui, one of the Polynesian islands in the Pacific Ocean. They spent weeks at sea before finally docking their double-hulled catamarans in what’s now Hawaii—around 4,400 miles from their homeland.
paras.zh: 大约 1000 年前，一群技术精湛的海员离开了复活节岛（也称为拉帕努伊岛），太平洋波利尼西亚群岛之一。他们在海上度过了数周时间，最终将双体双体船停靠在现在的夏威夷，距离​​他们的祖国大约 4,400 英里。

paras.en: Researchers reported this surprising new insight into Hawaii’s first settlers on October 8 in the journal Science after analyzing genetic data from more than 1,000 modern-day Polynesians. What’s more, the “ultravoyaging” group’s far-flung journey is just part of a broader settlement process that populated Polynesia—but also brought genetic health hazards that affect people today.
paras.zh: 研究人员在分析了 1000 多名现代波利尼西亚人的遗传数据后，于 10 月 8 日在《科学》杂志上报告了这一关于夏威夷第一批定居者的令人惊讶的新见解。更重要的是，“超航”团体的遥远旅程只是波利尼西亚人口更广泛的定居过程的一部分，但也带来了影响当今人们的遗传健康危害。

paras.en: Polynesia is a large cultural and geographic region of the east-central Pacific Ocean that includes more than 1,000 islands. The Hawaiian Islands are the only ones located in the Northern Hemisphere, while Easter Island is far off the coast of Chile. Both sit more than 1,800 miles from another inhabited Polynesian island, meaning they’re “the two most remote islands in Polynesia,” study co-author Keolu Fox, an anthropologist at the University of California, San Diego, tells Olin Lagon at Honolulu Civil Beat.
paras.zh: 波利尼西亚是太平洋中东部的一个大型文化和地理区域，包括 1,000 多个岛屿。夏威夷群岛是唯一位于北半球的岛屿，而复活节岛则远离智利海岸。研究合著者、加州大学圣地亚哥分校的人类学家基奥卢·福克斯 (Keolu Fox) 告诉檀香山 Civil Beat 的奥林·拉根 (Olin Lagon)，这两个岛屿距离另一个有人居住的波利尼西亚岛屿均超过 1,800 英里，这意味着它们是“波利尼西亚最偏远的两个岛屿”。

paras.en: “If you had to guess which two islands were least related, you might pick those two,” he says.
paras.zh: “如果你必须猜测哪两个岛屿最不相关，你可能会选择那两个，”他说。

paras.en: And yet, Fox and colleagues found just that. In the study, the team analyzed the complete sets of genetic instructions, or genomes, from 1,050 Polynesian individuals, including 317 Native Hawaiians and 12 Easter Islanders. They specifically looked at the length of chromosomal segments shared among people from different islands. Longer shared segments between two people hint at a more recent common ancestor.
paras.zh: 然而，福克斯和同事发现了这一点。在这项研究中，研究小组分析了 1,050 名波利尼西亚人的完整遗传指令或基因组，其中包括 317 名夏威夷原住民和 12 名复活节岛民。他们专门研究了来自不同岛屿的人们共享的染色体片段的长度。两个人之间较长的共享片段暗示着更近的共同祖先。

paras.en: Based on that information, the team reconstructed thousands of family trees. “In 61 percent of those trees, Hawaii and Rapa Nui were paired together,” Fox tells Reuters’ Will Dunham. “We checked it four different ways because, frankly, we were dumbfounded and couldn’t believe it ourselves at first.” Native Hawaiians shared the second-highest ancestry with individuals from Mangareva, an island around 1,600 miles west of Easter Island.
paras.zh: 根据这些信息，该团队重建了数千个家谱。 “其中 61% 的树木中，夏威夷和拉帕努伊是配对的，”福克斯告诉路透社的威尔·邓纳姆。 “我们用四种不同的方式进行了检查，因为坦率地说，我们一开始都惊呆了，自己也不敢相信。”夏威夷原住民与来自复活节岛以西约 1,600 英里的曼阿雷瓦岛的人有着第二高的血统。

paras.en: The newly uncovered journey is the most recent addition to researchers’ understanding of the settlement pattern in Polynesia. In 2021, for instance, some of the same researchers reported that people traveled from Samoa through the Cook Islands, then to the Society Islands, followed by Mangareva. They finally reached Easter Island in approximately 1210.
paras.zh: 新发现的旅程是研究人员对波利尼西亚定居模式了解的最新补充。例如，2021 年，一些研究人员报告说，人们从萨摩亚出发，途经库克群岛，然后到达社会群岛，最后到达曼加雷瓦群岛。他们终于在大约1210年到达复活节岛。

paras.en: The recent study shows that this ultravoyaging culture didn’t stop there.
paras.zh: 最近的研究表明，这种超航文化并没有就此止步。

paras.en: The researchers call the ultravoyaging group Holomoana Nui, the Hawaiian phrase for “great ocean voyaging.”
paras.zh: 研究人员将超航小组命名为 Holomoana Nui，夏威夷语中的意思是“伟大的远洋航行”。

paras.en: Additionally, the genetic evidence bringing together Hawaii, Easter Island and Mangareva aligns with archaeological data, Patrick Kirch, an archaeologist at the University of Hawaii at Mānoa who did not participate in the study, tells Live Science’s Charles Q. Choi. “It gives scientists a lot of confidence when independent lines of evidence from different disciplines give similar results.”
paras.zh: 此外，未参与这项研究的夏威夷大学马诺阿分校考古学家帕特里克·基尔希 (Patrick Kirch) 告诉《生活科学》杂志的查尔斯·Q·崔 (Charles Q. Choi)，夏威夷、复活节岛和曼阿雷瓦岛的遗传证据与考古数据相符。 “当来自不同学科的独立证据给出相似的结果时，这给了科学家很大的信心。”

paras.en: What’s more, the study highlights that Polynesia’s settlement process made its populations vulnerable to what’s known as founder effects, which happens when a small group leaves a community to found a new one. The founders of the new community have a shrunken gene pool with limited diversity, which can increase the occurrence of usually rare genetic variants, including those associated with disease.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，该研究强调，波利尼西亚的定居过程使其人口容易受到所谓的创始人效应的影响，当一小群人离开一个社区去寻找新社区时就会发生这种情况。新社区的创始人拥有一个萎缩的基因库，多样性有限，这可能会增加通常罕见的遗传变异的发生率，包括与疾病相关的变异。

paras.en: These effects have been well studied in populations including the Amish, Ashkenazi Jews and Finns, leading to the establishment of genetic screenings for certain issues among their groups. The new findings suggest the same needs to be done for Native Hawaiians, who are at the end of a nested series of founder events.
paras.zh: 这些影响已在包括阿米什人、阿什肯纳兹犹太人和芬兰人在内的人群中得到了深入研究，从而导致针对他们群体中的某些问题建立了基因筛查。新的发现表明，夏威夷原住民也需要做同样的事情，他们正处于一系列嵌套的创始人事件的末尾。

paras.en: “Even compared to Ashkenazi Jews, Polynesians have much stronger bottlenecks, the strongest ever reported. This has real implications for their health,” Cosimo Posth, a population geneticist at the University of Tübingen in Germany who did not participate in the study, tells the Washington Post’s Makana Eyre.
paras.zh: “即使与德系犹太人相比，波利尼西亚人也有更严重的瓶颈，是有史以来最严重的。这对他们的健康产生了真正的影响，”德国图宾根大学的人口遗传学家科西莫·波斯特（Cosimo Posth）告诉《华盛顿邮报》的马卡纳·艾尔（Makana Eyre），他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: For example, three analyzed genetic variants associated with vision or kidney issues, which are exceptionally rare in the global population, were present in 2 to 3 percent of the Eastern Polynesians who participated in the study. That’s enough to justify the establishment of genetic screening recommendations, according to a statement.
paras.zh: 例如，参与该研究的东波利尼西亚人中有 2％ 至 3％ 存在三种与视力或肾脏问题相关的遗传变异，这在全球人口中极为罕见。一份声明称，这足以证明建立基因筛查建议是合理的。

paras.en: “This is a population that should be getting research resources and attention from geneticists even more urgently,” says study co-author Alexander Ioannidis, a computational geneticist at Stanford University, in the statement.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、斯坦福大学计算遗传学家亚历山大·约安尼迪斯 (Alexander Ioannidis) 在声明中表示：“这个群体应该更迫切地获得研究资源和遗传学家的关注。”

articles.title: See a Stunning Simulation of the Early Universe, Which Will Help Astronomers Shed Light on the Cosmic Dark Ages

paras.en: At first, there was nothing; then, there was light. The universe was born in a rapid explosion of energy known as the Big Bang some 13.8 billion years ago. For the first 380,000 years, the universe was hot, dense soup: a relatively simple mix of negatively charged electrons and nuclei of the elements hydrogen and helium.
paras.zh: 起初，什么也没有；然后，就有光了。大约 138 亿年前，宇宙诞生于一次被称为“大爆炸”的快速能量爆炸中。在最初的 38 万年里，宇宙是热而浓的汤：带负电的电子与氢和氦元素的原子核的相对简单的混合物。

paras.en: But then, darkness descended. The universe cooled, allowing the electrons to join the hydrogen and helium, which coalesced into a neutral cloud of gas. Without an abundance of free electrons to scatter leftover energy from the Big Bang—and no stars or galaxies to give off light—the universe plunged into a period called the cosmic dark ages.
paras.zh: 但随后，黑暗降临了。宇宙冷却，使电子与氢和氦结合，形成中性气体云。由于没有大量的自由电子来分散大爆炸剩余的能量，也没有恒星或星系发出光，宇宙陷入了一个被称为宇宙黑暗时代的时期。

paras.en: While scientists have a good understanding of the Big Bang and its immediate aftermath, this second phase is less clear. “The dark ages is this transition from simple physics into this overwhelmingly complex physics,” explains Volker Bromm, an astronomer at the University of Texas at Austin.
paras.zh: 虽然科学家们对大爆炸及其直接后果有很好的了解，但第二阶段还不太清楚。德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的天文学家沃尔克·布罗姆解释说：“黑暗时代是从简单物理学向极其复杂物理学的转变。”

paras.en: Now, a new computer simulation built by researchers at the Center for Astrophysics, Harvard & Smithsonian, and other institutions is shedding light on this cloudy chapter of the early cosmos, and how the universe broke free of it. The team published their work in the November issue of the Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.
paras.zh: 现在，由天体物理中心、哈佛和史密森尼以及其他机构的研究人员构建的新计算机模拟正在揭示早期宇宙的这一阴云章节，以及宇宙如何摆脱它。该团队在 11 月号《皇家天文学会月刊》上发表了他们的研究成果。

paras.en: The simulation, dubbed Lumina, is one of the largest and most detailed models of the cosmic dark ages yet, spanning from 50 million to 200 million years after the Big Bang. It covers more than 100 times the volume of comparable simulations, according to a statement. Astrophysicists can use the model alongside new observations from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) and the new Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope to test theories on the early formation of the universe.
paras.zh: 这个名为 Lumina 的模拟是迄今为止最大、最详细的宇宙黑暗时代模型之一，时间跨度为大爆炸后 5000 万年至 2 亿年。根据一份声明，它的覆盖量是同类模拟的 100 多倍。天体物理学家可以使用该模型以及詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）和新的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜的新观测结果来测试宇宙早期形成的理论。

paras.en: “To understand what we are seeing with [these telescopes], we need to translate our theories into detailed predictions,” lead author Oliver Zier, a computational astrophysicist at the Center for Astrophysics, Harvard & Smithsonian, says in the statement. “After several years of work, with plenty of ups and downs, it is incredibly rewarding to see the simulation results and watch our predictions come to life in video.”
paras.zh: “为了理解我们用[这些望远镜]看到的东西，我们需要将我们的理论转化为详细的预测，”哈佛大学和史密森天体物理中心的计算天体物理学家、主要作者奥利弗·齐尔(Oliver Zier)在声明中说。 “经过几年的工作，经历了很多起起落落，看到模拟结果并观看我们的预测在视频中变为现实，这是非常值得的。”

paras.en: The simulation maps the development of the defining features of the modern universe, like dark matter, gas, stars and radiation, through a period called the epoch of reionization, Zier tells Smithsonian magazine. This transition phase, which ended the cosmic dark ages, was driven by electrons being pulled away from hydrogen and helium, creating charged particles, or ions.
paras.zh: 齐尔告诉《史密森尼》杂志，该模拟描绘了暗物质、气体、恒星和辐射等现代宇宙的定义特征在一个被称为“再电离时代”的时期的发展过程。这个结束了宇宙黑暗时代的过渡阶段是由氢和氦中的电子被拉走，产生带电粒子或离子所驱动的。

paras.en: This happened in two waves: First, as structures formed and energy coalesced into the first stars a few hundred million years after the Big Bang, their light removed hydrogen’s electron, turning the neutral atoms into free electrons and positively charged protons, Zier says. Ionization of helium, which has two electrons, proved harder. Starlight was powerful enough to dislodge the element’s first electron, but it took more radiation from developing supermassive black holes to remove the second. The simulation also showed this process did not occur evenly across the cosmos.
paras.zh: 齐尔说，这分两波发生：首先，随着结构的形成和能量在大爆炸后几亿年凝聚成第一批恒星，它们的光消除了氢的电子，将中性原子变成自由电子和带正电的质子。事实证明，具有两个电子的氦的电离更加困难。星光的强度足以驱逐该元素的第一个电子，但需要更多来自发展中的超大质量黑洞的辐射才能去除第二个电子。模拟还表明，这个过程在整个宇宙中并不是均匀发生的。

paras.en: “In these early stages, ionization is not uniform,” Zier says. “We see these bubbles of ionization around big structures, but there are still vast stretches of the universe still in a neutral state.”
paras.zh: “在这些早期阶段，电离并不均匀，”齐尔说。 “我们在大型结构周围看到这些电离气泡，但宇宙仍有大片区域仍处于中性状态。”

paras.en: Lumina captures these processes in video representations—webs of emanating radiation that eventually expand to encompass the entire universe in a new era of light. To produce this, the team used the Frontier supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. At its peak, the project used about 600 terabytes of memory, roughly the storage space needed for 150,000 high-definition movies.
paras.zh: Lumina 以视频形式捕捉这些过程——发出的辐射网最终扩展到新光时代的整个宇宙。为了实现这一目标，该团队使用了橡树岭国家实验室的 Frontier 超级计算机。在高峰期，该项目使用了约 600 TB 的内存，大约相当于 150,000 部高清电影所需的存储空间。

paras.en: “This is an incredible feat of engineering,” says Julian Muñoz, a theoretical cosmologist at UT Austin who was not involved in the project. “Making such a big simulation work efficiently in modern-day supercomputers and run for as long as it had to run to get helium reionization—it’s truly impressive.”
paras.zh: “这是一项令人难以置信的工程壮举，”德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的理论宇宙学家朱利安·穆尼奥斯（Julian Muñoz）说道，他没有参与该项目。 “让如此大型的模拟在现代超级计算机中高效运行，并且运行时间与获得氦再电离所需的时间一样长，这确实令人印象深刻。”

paras.en: Also novel is the project’s scale: Lumina spans 1.5 billion light-years on each side and encompasses 200 million galaxies while still enabling astronomers to zoom into the level of individual galaxies and see their development in detail. Lumina is part of a line of supercomputer-made models of the early cosmos, including the 2005 Millenium Simulation and the 2017 IllustrisTNG. The latter provided the foundation for Lumina, and many of the same scientists were involved in both projects.
paras.zh: 该项目的规模也很新颖：Lumina 每边跨越 15 亿光年，涵盖 2 亿个星系，同时仍然使天文学家能够放大单个星系的水平并详细了解它们的发展。 Lumina 是超级计算机制作的早期宇宙模型系列的一部分，包括 2005 年的 Millenium 模拟和 2017 年的 IllustrisTNG。后者为 Lumina 奠定了基础，许多相同的科学家都参与了这两个项目。

paras.en: To run Lumina, the team used more than 100,000 computer processing unit cores and about 15,000 graphic processing units—enough to power thousands of high-performance computers. Altogether, the program took roughly six months to run through all its lines of code.
paras.zh: 为了运行 Lumina，该团队使用了超过 100,000 个计算机处理单元核心和大约 15,000 个图形处理单元，足以为数千台高性能计算机提供动力。该程序总共花了大约六个月的时间来运行所有代码行。

paras.en: To give scientists an accurate model to test their theories, Bromm, who was not involved in the research, explains these simulations need to encompass a wide enough portion of space in their “box” to accurately reflect the cosmos’ diversity. This size also ensures scientists aren’t missing major astrophysical action spots, like large galaxy clusters and supermassive black holes. At the same time, scientists need simulations with enough detail to examine these phenomena on an individual basis. Lumina is novel, he says, in providing both.
paras.zh: 为了给科学家提供一个准确的模型来测试他们的理论，没有参与这项研究的布罗姆解释说，这些模拟需要在“盒子”中包含足够宽的空间部分，以准确反映宇宙的多样性。这个尺寸还确保科学家不会错过主要的天体物理作用点，例如大型星系团和超大质量黑洞。与此同时，科学家需要足够详细的模拟来逐一检查这些现象。他说，Lumina 很新颖，同时提供了这两种功能。

paras.en: “All of this is really pushing the envelope. [Lumina] extends this illustrious line of computer simulations to the next stage,” Bromm says. “In terms of the size, I would say, they might have almost reached the end of the size of the box.”
paras.zh: “所有这一切都真正挑战了极限。[Lumina] 将这一杰出的计算机模拟系列扩展到了下一个阶段，”布罗姆说。 “就尺寸而言，我想说，它们可能几乎已经达到了盒子尺寸的极限。”

paras.en: This innovation comes alongside the recent development of both the JWST and the Roman space telescope, which can see light that has traveled toward Earth for billions of years, allowing astronomers to peer at the young universe. Using these tools, astronomers have observed the presence of bright galaxies and supermassive black holes—things that should not be there according to leading theories of early cosmic development, Zier says. Lumina will allow researchers to test these theories against the new observations and, he hopes, help solve these tensions.
paras.zh: 这项创新与 JWST 和罗马太空望远镜最近的发展同时进行，它们可以看到数十亿年来向地球传播的光线，使天文学家能够观察年轻的宇宙。齐尔说，利用这些工具，天文学家观察到了明亮星系和超大质量黑洞的存在——根据早期宇宙发展的主要理论，这些东西不应该存在。 Lumina 将使研究人员能够根据新的观察结果来测试这些理论，他希望这有助于解决这些紧张局势。

paras.en: JWST “can study individual objects in great detail, while Roman will survey much larger areas of the sky and find larger samples of rare, bright galaxies,” Zier explains. “Comparing both their abundance and clustering with simulations like Lumina will help us distinguish between different explanations for the unexpectedly large number of bright galaxies in the early universe.”
paras.zh: 詹姆斯韦伯太空望远镜“可以非常详细地研究单个物体，而罗曼将调查更大的天空区域，并找到更大的稀有、明亮星系样本，”齐尔解释道。 “将它们的丰度和聚类与 Lumina 等模拟进行比较，将有助于我们区分对早期宇宙中出乎意料的大量明亮星系的不同解释。”

paras.en: Beyond offering scientists a new tool to study the universe, Lumina also offers a chance to watch in vivid detail the early formation of the universe—and the processes that began the long march to humanity.
paras.zh: 除了为科学家提供研究宇宙的新工具外，Lumina 还提供了一个机会，生动地详细观察宇宙的早期形成以及人类开始长征的过程。

paras.en: “People want to know where we come from,” Zier says. “Lumina gives us a look into that past.”
paras.zh: “人们想知道我们来自哪里，”齐尔说。 “Lumina 让我们回顾了过去。”

articles.title: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
articles.author: David Gilbert

paras.en: As Americans go to the polls today, many will have had their decision about who to vote for informed by an artificial intelligence–powered chatbot.
paras.zh: 当美国人今天去投票时，许多人将通过人工智能驱动的聊天机器人来决定投票给谁。

paras.en: Around 50 percent of recently surveyed US adults have at one time used an AI chatbot, and 8 percent say they have used these tools ahead of the midterms to find information on candidates and policies, according to Pew Research.
paras.zh: 皮尤研究中心 (Pew Research) 的数据显示，最近接受调查的美国成年人中，大约 50% 的人曾经使用过人工智能聊天机器人，8% 的人表示他们在中期选举前使用这些工具来查找有关候选人和政策的信息。

paras.en: But a lot of information from these chatbots is out of date and has been hallucinated or sourced from partisan websites.
paras.zh: 但来自这些聊天机器人的许多信息已经过时，并且是幻觉或来自党派网站。

paras.en: Even supposedly nonpartisan chatbots like OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude, and Google’s Gemini have been found wanting when it comes to questions about the midterms.
paras.zh: 即使是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT、Anthropic 的 Claude 和 Google 的 Gemini 等所谓的无党派聊天机器人在涉及中期选举问题时也被发现存在不足。

paras.en: Just last week, Google’s AI Mode refused to provide the results of the 2020 elections, and the company’s Gemini chatbot said the deadline to request a mail-in ballot in Pennsylvania was November 3, rather than the real deadline of October 27, according to research by Forum AI.
paras.zh: 就在上周，谷歌的 AI Mode 拒绝提供 2020 年选举结果，根据 Forum AI 的研究，该公司的 Gemini 聊天机器人表示，宾夕法尼亚州要求邮寄选票的截止日期是 11 月 3 日，而不是 10 月 27 日。

paras.en: According to the Forum AI research, almost 40 percent of election answers given by all the mainstream chatbots contained at least one factual error. In August, when Forum AI’s researchers asked why someone should vote for North Carolina congressman Don Davis, Claude gave a response that conflated the lawmaker with a “former school superintendent” of the same name.
paras.zh: 根据 Forum AI 的研究，所有主流聊天机器人给出的选举答案中，近 40% 至少包含一个事实错误。 8 月，当人工智能论坛的研究人员询问为什么有人应该投票给北卡罗来纳州国会议员唐·戴维斯时，克劳德的回答将这位立法者与同名的“前学校校长”混为一谈。

paras.en: Google and Anthropic did not respond to requests for comment. Open AI directed WIRED to a blog outlining the company’s approach to elections in 2026.
paras.zh: 谷歌和 Anthropic 没有回应置评请求。 Open AI 向《连线》杂志推荐了一篇博客，概述了该公司应对 2026 年选举的方法。

paras.en: Part of the problem is that chatbots are reliant on an increasingly problematic pool of online information. Research by NewsGuard found that mainstream chatbots cite so-called “pink slime” websites nearly 50 percent of the time when asked about candidates and policies related to the midterms. Pink slime sites present as mainstream news websites but are in fact funded by political or ideological groups and individuals.
paras.zh: 部分问题在于聊天机器人依赖于问题日益严重的在线信息库。 NewsGuard 的研究发现，当被问及与中期选举相关的候选人和政策时，主流聊天机器人近 50% 的时间都会引用所谓的“粉红史莱姆”网站。粉红色粘液网站看似主流新闻网站，但实际上是由政治或意识形态团体和个人资助的。

paras.en: Ahead of the midterms, many more of these sites have sprung up, and chatbots are paying attention. The worst offender, according to NewsGuard, was OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which cited the pink slime sites in more than 70 percent of searches, while xAI’s Grok chatbot performed best, citing pink slime sites in 30 percent of cases.
paras.zh: 在中期选举之前，更多此类网站如雨后春笋般涌现，聊天机器人正在关注。据 NewsGuard 称，最严重的违规者是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT，它在超过 70% 的搜索中引用了粉红色粘液网站，而 xAI 的 Grok 聊天机器人表现最好，在 30% 的搜索中引用了粉红色粘液网站。

paras.en: “I don't think that most Americans are prepared to navigate an election in the age of consumer AI,” Nina Jankowicz, executive director of the American Sunlight Project and a former disinformation czar during the Biden administration, tells WIRED. “One of the problems is that executives and companies have really overpromised on what AI is capable of. It has to ingest this information from somewhere, and often those sources are not very good. And it's predictive, so if it doesn't know the answer, it does frequently make things up.”
paras.zh: 美国阳光项目执行董事、拜登政府期间的前虚假信息沙皇尼娜·扬科维奇 (Nina Jankowicz) 告诉《连线》杂志：“我认为大多数美国人还没有准备好应对消费者人工智能时代的选举。” “问题之一是，高管和公司对人工智能的能力确实夸大了。它必须从某个地方获取这些信息，而这些来源往往不是很好。而且它具有预测性，所以如果它不知道答案，它经常会编造一些东西。”
